title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
english: Five years after the Taliban returned to power in Afghanistan, women report that their lives have been completely transformed by severe new restrictions. Girls are now prohibited from attending school beyond the primary level, and women face strict limits on their movement and personal freedoms. Many residents express that their focus has shifted entirely to surviving poverty, as their hopes for education and professional careers have been shattered.

title: Trump asks US Supreme Court to allow $400m ballroom project to proceed
english: President Donald Trump’s administration has petitioned the Supreme Court to permit the continued construction of a $400 million ballroom at the White House. This request follows a lower court ruling that requires congressional approval for the project, which critics argue is an unauthorized use of taxpayer funds. The Department of Justice contends that the building project is essential for national security, despite ongoing legal challenges regarding its legality and historic impact.

title: Woman charged over vandalism of World War II Memorial in Washington, DC
english: A 41-year-old woman named Melissa Farris has been arrested and charged with felonies for vandalizing the World War II Memorial in Washington, DC. Authorities claim she defaced the monument with graffiti and soap after a prior incident involving damage to the Reflecting Pool. If convicted, she faces a potential sentence of up to 10 years in prison for destroying the veterans' memorial.
amharic: ሜሊሳ ፋሪስ የተባለች የ41 ዓመት ሴት በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ በሚገኘው የሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት መታሰቢያ ሐውልት ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሷ በቁጥጥር ስር ውላለች። ተጠርጣሪዋ በሐውልቱ ላይ ቀለም በመቀባትና ሳሙና በመጠቀም ጉዳት ማድረሷን ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል። ጥፋተኛ ሆና ከተገኘች፣ የጦር አርበኞች መታሰቢያን በማበላሸት እስከ 10 ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊፈረድባት ይችላል።

Yakka kana irratti kan itti murta'u yoo ta'e, yaaddannoo kabajamuu kana mancaasuu isheetiif hanga waggaa 10 hidhamaa itti murta'uu danda'a.

title: Art offers young Gaza survivors solace and escape from war’s devastation
english: Young Palestinians in Gaza are using art classes at a local beach cafe as a vital way to cope with the profound trauma of the ongoing war. By expressing their painful experiences through drawing, survivors like 16-year-old Maryam are finding a temporary escape from their difficult reality. These creative sessions provide the youth with a sense of relief, personal achievement, and a renewed feeling of hope during incredibly challenging times.

title: Italian police recover stolen paintings worth over $10m
english: Italian authorities have successfully recovered three valuable paintings worth over $10 million that were stolen from a museum near Parma in March. Police identified nine Moldovan nationals as suspects, with five of them believed to be directly involved in the rapid break-in. The recovered masterpieces include works by renowned artists Paul Cezanne, Pierre-Auguste Renoir, and Henri Matisse.

title: Houthis say they targeted Aramco in Saudi Arabia's Najran with drone
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for a drone strike against an Aramco oil facility located in the Saudi Arabian city of Najran. The group reported that the operation was successful in hitting its intended target. No further details regarding the extent of the damage or potential casualties were provided by the rebels.

oromo: Warreen Houthi kan Yemen, magaalaa Najran kan Saudi Arabia keessatti buufata boba'aa Aramco irratti xiyyara gargaarsa malee (drone) fayyadamuun haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsan. title: CEO pay skyrockets in 2025 amid growing income inequality in the US
english: A new report reveals that the pay gap between US CEOs and their employees grew significantly in 2025, with top executives earning 312 times the average worker's salary. Tesla CEO Elon Musk represented a extreme outlier, earning millions of times more than his employees despite a decline in his company's sales and revenue. Labor experts warn that this massive income inequality may encourage executives to prioritize short-term personal gain over the long-term stability of their businesses and the economy.
amharic: አዲስ ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው በ2025 በአሜሪካ የኩባንያ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚዎች እና ሰራተኞች መካከል ያለው የደመወዝ ክፍተት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል፣ ይህም ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚዎች ከአማካይ ሰራተኛ 312 እጥፍ ገቢ እንዲያገኙ አድርጓል። የቴስላው ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ኤሎን ማስክ የኩባንያው ገቢ እና ሽያጭ ቢቀንስም፣ ከተራ ሰራተኞቻቸው በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ እጥፍ ደመወዝ በማግኘት ከፍተኛ ልዩነት አሳይተዋል። የሰራተኛ ማህበራት ባለሙያዎች ይህ ከፍተኛ የሀብት ክፍፍል ስራ አስፈፃሚዎች ለድርጅታቸው የረጅም ጊዜ ደህንነት ከመጨነቅ ይልቅ ለአጭር ጊዜ የግል ጥቅም ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraan akka agarsiisutti bara 2025tti Ameerikaa keessatti gargarummaan mindaa hoogganootaa fi hojjattoota gidduu jiru guddateera; hoogganoonni olaanoon mindaa hojjataa giddu-galeessaa yeroo 312 argatu. title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in UnitedHealthcare CEO’s killing
english: Luigi Mangione has formally admitted to the 2024 murder of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in Manhattan. During his court appearance, he confessed to the fatal shooting of the executive. He is now facing a potential sentence of life imprisonment for the crime.

title: Pro-Israel Emirati influencers mocked for claims of Islamic plot to take over West
english: Several Emirati influencers are facing widespread ridicule for promoting conspiracy theories about an alleged Islamic plot to seize control of Western countries. These individuals recently appeared in interviews suggesting that the Muslim Brotherhood poses a significant threat to Britain. Their claims have sparked strong backlash after they were associated with figures known for anti-Islamic rhetoric and far-right connections.

title: Hezbollah accuses Lebanon’s government of targeting ‘resistance’ instead of Israel: Report
english: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem has criticized the Lebanese government, accusing officials of failing to protect the country against Israeli aggression. He argued that the authorities are prioritizing actions against his group rather than addressing the ongoing displacement of citizens in southern towns like Mansouri. Qassem further condemned the government for what he described as a surrender to sovereignty violations, despite existing ceasefire agreements.

title: Morale on US aircraft carrier enforcing Iran blockade plummets, as sailor jumps overboard: Report
english: The U.S. Navy is replacing the USS Abraham Lincoln with the USS George Washington in the Middle East following reports of poor mental health and low morale among the crew. Sailors on the Lincoln have been at sea for over 250 days without visiting a port, leading to distressing incidents involving members jumping overboard. This rotation occurs as the U.S. remains committed to maintaining a blockade near the Strait of Hormuz despite the ongoing regional conflict.

oromo: Humnooni galaanaa Ameerikaa, hojjettoota markaba USS Abraham Lincoln irraa gabaasamee kan jiru dhiphina sammuu fi abdii kutannoo hordofee, markabicha USS George Washingtoniin bakka buusuuf murteessaniiru. title: Morale on US aircraft carrier enforcing Iran blockade plummets, as sailor jumps overboard: Report
english: The US Navy is replacing the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln with the USS George Washington after reports of severe mental health issues and declining morale among the crew. Sailors have been stuck at sea for over 250 days without a port visit while enforcing a blockade against Iran, leading to incidents where crew members attempted to jump overboard. Lawmakers and officials are now addressing these deteriorating conditions as the long-term blockade continues.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል በአውሮፕላን ተሸካሚው መርከብ USS Abraham Lincoln ላይ የሚገኙ መርከበኞች ከፍተኛ የአእምሮ ጤና ቀውስ እና የሞራል ውድቀት እንዳጋጠማቸው በመዘገቡ ምክንያት መርከቧን በ USS George Washington ለመተካት ወስኗል። መርከበኞቹ ኢራንን ለመዝጋት በሚደረገው ዘመቻ ከ250 ቀናት በላይ ወደ ወደብ ሳይገቡ በባህር ላይ በመቆየታቸው፣ አንዳንዶች እራሳቸውን ለማጥፋት ወደ ባህር የዘለሉበት ሁኔታ ተከስቷል። በዚህ ረጅም ጊዜ የቆየው የጦር ሰፈር ዘመቻ ምክንያት የተፈጠረው የሰራተኞች ችግር አሁን በአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ዘንድ አሳሳቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Raayyaan waraana galaanaa Ameerikaa doonii xiyyaara baattu USS Abraham Lincoln jedhamtu, yaaddoo fayyaa sammuu fi jeeqama haala jireenyaa hojjettoota ishee mudateen walqabatee doonii USS George Washingtonn akka bakka bu'u murteesseera. title: Activists try to deliver aid to Palestinians in homes besieged by Israeli settlers
english: Activists attempted to provide food and water to Palestinian families trapped in their homes in the West Bank after Israeli settlers blocked their access and cut off utilities. While the activists managed to leave supplies nearby, they faced restrictions from military forces that had designated the area a closed zone. The Israeli military claims they are working to protect residents and remove the settlers, though local officials report that soldiers have occupied some of the vacated Palestinian homes.

title: Liverpool to sell minority stake to consortium including Jeff Bezos
english: Fenway Sports Group has agreed to sell a one-third minority stake in Liverpool FC to a group called 1892 Holdings, which includes Amazon founder Jeff Bezos. While the new partners will join the board and take on leadership roles, the current owners will retain majority control of the club. This partnership aims to support the team's long-term success as they begin their upcoming season.
amharic: የሊቨርፑል እግር ኳስ ክለብ ባለቤት የሆነው ፌንዌይ ስፖርትስ ግሩፕ፣ የአማዞን መስራች ጄፍ ቤዞስን ያካተተ 1892 ሆልዲንግስ ለተባለ ቡድን የክለቡን አንድ ሶስተኛ ድርሻ ለመሸጥ ተስማምቷል። አዲሶቹ ባለሃብቶች በክለቡ ቦርድ ውስጥ ቢካተቱም፣ የአሁኑ ባለቤቶች በክለቡ ላይ ዋናውን ቁጥጥር እንደያዙ ይቀጥላሉ። ይህ አጋርነት ክለቡ ለወደፊቱ የሚያስመዘግበውን ስኬት ለመደገፍ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Gareen kubbaa miilaa Liverpool abbaa qabeenyaa isaa kan ta'e Fenway Sports Group, garee 1892 Holdings jedhamuuf, kan keessatti hundeeessaan Amazon Jeff Bezos argaman, harka sadii keessaa tokko ($1/3$) gurguruuf waliigaltee irra ga'eera. Abbootiin qabeenyaa haaraan kun boordii klabichaa keessatti kan hirmaatan ta'us, abbootiin qabeenyaa amma jiran klabicharratti aangoo guutuu qabaachuudha itti fufu. Waliigalteen kun klabichi fuuldurattis milkaa'ina akka argatu gargaaruuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow ballroom work to continue
english: President Trump has requested that the Supreme Court permit the continued construction of a $400 million White House ballroom despite a recent appeals court order to halt work. The administration argues that the facility is necessary for national security and large-scale events, and maintains that private funding eliminates the need for congressional approval. Legal opponents, including the National Trust for Historic Preservation, contend that the project violates regulations by bypassing mandatory reviews and public oversight.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዋይት ሀውስ እየተገነባ ያለውን የ400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የዳንስ አዳራሽ ግንባታ እንዲቀጥል ለጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል። የይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት ግንባታውን እንዲያቆም ትዕዛዝ ቢሰጥም፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ፕሮጀክቱ ለሀገር ደህንነት እና ለትላልቅ ዝግጅቶች ወሳኝ በመሆኑ የግል ገንዘብ ስለሚጠቀም የፓርላማ ፈቃድ አያስፈልገውም በማለት ይከራከራል። የሀገሪቱን ታሪካዊ ቅርሶች ጠባቂ ድርጅትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ተቃዋሚዎች ግን ፕሮጀክቱ ህጋዊ ምርመራዎችን እና የህዝብ ተሳትፎን የዘለለ በመሆኑ ስህተት ነው ይላሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp mana maree olaanaa irratti, ijaarsa daarii bal'aa mana mootummaa (White House) kan $400 miliyoona itti ba'aa jiru, ajaja mana murtii ol'iyyannoo irraa dhufeen alatti akka itti fufu gaafataniiru. Bulchiinsi isaanii, ijaarsi kun nageenya biyyaafis ta'e qophiiwwan gurguddaaf barbaachisaa dha, akkasumas maallaqni isaa kan dhuunfaa waan ta'eef hayyama mana maree seera baastuu hin barbaadu jedhaniiru. Gareewwan ijaarsa kana mormanis, ijaarsi kun adeemsa seeraa fi qorannoo barbaachisu hunda utuu hin hordofin jalqabame jechuun himatu.

title: Analysis: Israel’s government can’t disown West Bank settler violence
english: Rights groups and critics argue that the Israeli government is complicit in the ongoing settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank. Although officials have publicly condemned recent attacks in Qusra, experts claim these statements are insincere because the military often protects or joins the settlers. Ultimately, analysts suggest that this state-supported aggression is part of a broader policy aimed at displacing Palestinians and annexing their land.
amharic: የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች እና ተቺዎች የእስራኤል መንግስት በዌስት ባንክ በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ በሚፈጸም የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት እጁ አለበት ብለው ያምናሉ። ባለስልጣናት በቅርቡ በቁስራ መንደር የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት በይፋ ቢያወግዙም፣ ወታደሮች ሰፋሪዎችን የሚከላከሉበት ወይም ከእነሱ ጋር አብረው የሚሰሩበት ሁኔታ በመኖሩ ውግዘቱ ተቀባይነት አጥቷል። በአጠቃላይ ይህ በመንግስት ድጋፍ የሚፈጸም ጥቃት ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቀያቸው ለማፈናቀል እና መሬታቸውን ለመውረስ የታቀደ የፖለቲካ አካሄድ መሆኑ ይነገራል።
oromo: Gumiiwwan mirga namoomaa fi qeeqonni akka jedhanitti, mootummaan Israa'el ganda Weest Baank keessatti weerartoonni (settlers) namoota Falasxiin irratti haleellaa raawwataniif itti gaafatamummaa qaba. Mootummaan haleellaa dhihoo kana ganda Qusraa keessatti raawwatame kan balaaleffate ta'us, loltoonni Israa'el weerartoota kana kan ittisan ykn isaan waliin kan hojjetan waan ta'eef qeeqonni kun soba jedhu. Walumaagalatti, haleellaan mootummaan deeggaramu kun, Falasxiinota qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqisuu fi lafa isaanii dhuunfachuu kan kaayyeeffate ta'uu isaa ogeeyyonni ni ibsu.

title: What’s next for far-right Reform UK after Farage’s by-election win?
english: Nigel Farage has secured re-election to the UK Parliament representing his party, Reform UK. However, the leader now faces significant uncertainty as an investigation into his financial dealings looms. This inquiry could potentially jeopardize his political career and negatively impact the party's future standing.
amharic: ናይጄል ፋራጅ የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲን በመወከል በድጋሚ ወደ ብሪታኒያ ፓርላማ ተመርጠዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የፓርቲው መሪ አሁን በፋይናንሻል ጉዳዮቻቸው ላይ እየተካሄደ ባለው ምርመራ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ፈተና ተጋርጦባቸዋል። ይህ ምርመራ የፖለቲካ ህይወታቸውን ለአደጋ ሊዳርግ እና በፓርቲያቸው ላይ ተጽዕኖ ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል እየተነገረ ነው።
oromo: Naayjel Faaraaj paartii Reform UK bakka bu'uudhaan irra deebi'ee mana maree biyyattii (Parliament) keessatti filatameera. Ta'us, hogganaan kun amma qorannoo dhimma faayinaansii isaa irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee rakkoo siyaasaa cimaa keessa galeera. Qorannoon kun gara fuulduraatti hojii isaa siyaasaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu fi sadarkaa paartichaa miidhuu danda'a.

title: Philippines drug war victims seek justice through truth commission
english: Families of victims from the Philippines' former drug war are presenting testimonies to an independent truth commission to seek accountability for state-sanctioned killings. The commission is investigating thousands of deaths that occurred during Rodrigo Duterte's administration, often involving vigilante violence or police operations. Forensic experts are supporting these efforts by examining remains to uncover the truth behind these extrajudicial executions.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ የቀድሞ የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ጦርነት ሰለባ የሆኑ ቤተሰቦች ለተፈጸሙት ግድያዎች ተጠያቂነትን ለማምጣት ለገለልተኛ የእውነት ኮሚሽን ምስክርነት እየሰጡ ነው። ኮሚሽኑ በሮድሪጎ ዱተርቴ አስተዳደር ወቅት የተፈጸሙ እና ብዙ ጊዜ በፖሊስ ወይም በታጣቂ ቡድኖች የተከናወኑትን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ግድያዎችን እየመረመረ ነው። የፎረንሲክ ባለሙያዎችም በእነዚህ ሕገ-ወጥ ግድያዎች ዙሪያ ያለውን እውነታ ለማረጋገጥ የአስከሬን ምርመራ በማድረግ እየተባበሩ ነው።
oromo: Maatiin namoota duula farra qoricha sammua nama hadoochu kan durii Filippinsi keessatti ajjeefamanii, himata fi gaafatamummaa argachuuf komishinii dhugaa baasuu walaba ta'eef ragaa dhiyeessaa jiru. Komishinichi namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawaman yeroo bulchiinsa Rodrigoo Dutertee keessa ajjeefaman, kanneen polisii ykn garee hidhattootaan raawwataman qorachaa jira. Ogeeyyonni faayiniiwwan (forensic) reeffa qorachuun dhugaa ajjeechaa seeran ala raawwatame kana ifa baasuuf gargaarsa gochaa jiru.

title: Top French court upholds assisted dying law, rejects teen social media ban
english: France's highest court has approved a new law allowing assisted dying for patients suffering from incurable and terminal conditions under strict oversight. At the same time, the court rejected a separate government proposal that aimed to prohibit children under 15 from using social media, citing concerns over freedom of expression. These rulings represent a mixed outcome for President Macron, who had actively supported both legislative initiatives.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ሊታከም በማይችል ህመም ለሚሰቃዩ ታማሚዎች በልዩ ሁኔታ ህይወታቸውን በህክምና እንዲያጠፉ የሚፈቅደውን ህግ አጽድቋል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ከ15 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናት ማህበራዊ ሚዲያ እንዳይጠቀሙ የሚከለክለውን ሌላ ረቂቅ ህግ የመግለጽ ነፃነትን በመጥቀስ ውድቅ አድርጎታል። እነዚህ ውሳኔዎች ሁለቱንም ህጎች ሲደግፉ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን ድብልቅ ውጤት እንዲያገኙ አድርጓቸዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Faransaayi dhukkuba fayyuun hin danda'amneen kan dararamaa jiranuf haala addaa ta'een gargaarsa du'aa (assisted dying) heyyamuu seeraan raggaasiseera. Yeroo walfakkaatuu, mana murtichi daa'imman umriin isaanii waggaa 15 gadi ta'e miidiyaa hawaasummaa akka hin fayyadamne dhorkuuf yaalamee ture mirga yaada ibsachuu sarbuudhaan seera ala taasiseera. Murtiin kun Pirezidaant Imaanueeli Maakroon irratti kan hundaa'e ta'us, bu'aan isaa gama lamaan qabaachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Mangione pleads guilty to federal charges in UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
english: Luigi Mangione has officially pleaded guilty to federal charges regarding the 2024 assassination of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson. During the court appearance, Mangione admitted to researching and targeting the executive after posing as an investor to track his movements. While he has accepted responsibility for these federal crimes, he still faces separate state-level murder charges for which his original not-guilty plea remains active.
amharic: ሉዊጂ ማንግዮን በ2024 የዩናይትድ ሄልዝ ኬር ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ብሪያን ቶምፕሰንን በመግደል የወንጀል ክስ ጥፋተኝነቱን በፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት አምኗል። ተከሳሹ የድርጅቱን መረጃ ለመሰብሰብ ባለሀብት መስሎ በመቅረብ ኢላማውን እንደጠበቀ በችሎት ተናግሯል። ምንም እንኳን በፌዴራል ክሱ ጥፋተኛነቱን ቢቀበልም፣ በክልል ደረጃ በቀረቡበት የነፍስ ማጥፋት ክስ ላይ ቀደም ሲል የገቡት የክህደት ቃል እንደፀና ነው።
oromo: Luwiiji Maangiyoonee bara 2024 ajjeechaa hoji geggeessaa olaanaa Yuunaytid Heelth Keer (UnitedHealthcare) Biriyaanii Toompsan irratti raawwatame ilaalchisee himata federaalaa irratti dhiyaateef yakka isaa amaneera. Mana murtiitti dhiyaatee akka ibsetti, namichi kun ragaa walitti qabachuuf akka invastaraatti of dhiyeessuun ajjeechaa kana akka karoorfate ibseera. Himata federaalaa kana irratti yakka isaa kan amane ta'us, himata ajjeechaa sadarkaa naannootti irratti banamee jiru irratti duraan waan mormeef, himatichi ammas itti fufa.

title: Qatar challenges AFC over open letter attacking FIFA President Infantino
english: The Qatar Football Association has formally challenged the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) for issuing a public letter against FIFA President Gianni Infantino without consulting its members. Qatar's football president stated that they were not informed or included in the decision to join UEFA and CONCACAF in calling for Infantino’s resignation. This dispute highlights significant internal disagreement within the AFC regarding the leadership crisis currently facing FIFA.
amharic: የኳታር እግር ኳስ ማህበር፣ የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን (AFC) አባላቱን ሳያማክር በፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ላይ የጋራ መግለጫ በማውጣቱ ቅሬታውን ገልጿል። የኳታር እግር ኳስ ፕሬዝዳንት እንደገለጹት፣ ከሌሎች ኮንፌዴሬሽኖች ጋር በመሆን ኢንፋንቲኖ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ ጥሪ በሚያቀርበው ደብዳቤ ላይ ለመስማማት ምንም አይነት ምክክር አልተደረገም። ይህ ክስተት በፊፋ አመራር ቀውስ ላይ የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን አባላት መካከል ያለውን ከፍተኛ ክፍፍል ያሳያል።
oromo: Waldaan kubbaa miillaa Qatar, gamtaa kubbaa miillaa Eshiyaa (AFC) miseensota isaa osoo hin mariisisiin fiifa (FIFA) irratti ibsa waamicha gaafatu baasuu isaa mormeera. Pirezidaantiin waldaa kubbaa miillaa Qatar akka ibsanitti, pirezidaantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantiino aangoo gadhiisuu qabu kan jedhu ibsa irratti akkaataa itti murtaa'e irratti isaan hin hirmaanne akkasumas hin mariisifamne. Falmiin kun rakkoo hogganummaa FIFA irratti gamtaa AFC keessatti addaan ba'iinsi cimaan akka jiru ifa godha.

title: ‘The party of the Cubans’: How Republicans courted a key South Florida vote
english: Cuban Americans in South Florida continue to be a strong base of support for the Republican Party despite some recent local political changes. Analysts note that this long-standing loyalty was cultivated through decades of intentional political engagement and alignment with the community’s opposition to socialism. While immigration concerns exist, the Republican Party remains the preferred choice for most of this demographic heading into the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: ምንም እንኳን በቅርቡ አንዳንድ የአካባቢ የፖለቲካ ለውጦች ቢኖሩም፣ በደቡብ ፍሎሪዳ የሚኖሩ ኩባዊ አሜሪካውያን ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ጠንካራ ድጋፍ መስጠታቸውን ቀጥለዋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚገልጹት፣ ይህ የረዥም ጊዜ ታማኝነት የተገነባው በአስርተ ዓመታት ውስጥ በተደረገ የፖለቲካ ትኩረት እና ማህበረሰቡ ሶሻሊዝምን በመቃወሙ ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የስደተኞች ጉዳይ አሳሳቢ ቢሆንም፣ ለመጪው የመሃል ጊዜ ምርጫ አብዛኛው የዚህ ማህበረሰብ ክፍል አሁንም ሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲን መርጠዋል።
oromo: Haa ta'u malee, jijjiiramni siyaasaa naannoo tokko tokko mul'atus, lammiileen Ameerikaa jireenya isaanii kibba Florida jiraatan deeggarsa cimaa paartii Rippaabilikaanif kennuu itti fufaniiru. Akka ogeeyyiin ibsanitti, amanamummaan kun waggoota dheeraaf qophii fi xiyyeeffannoo siyaasaa akkasumas mormii hawaasichi sirna soshalizimii irratti qabuun kan dhufe dha. Dhimmi godaantotaa damdamii ta'us, baay'een isaanii filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa dhufuuf paartii Rippaabilikaan filatanii jiru.

title: Ahmed al-Sharaa: A New Vision for Syria
english: Following the collapse of the al-Assad regime in late 2024, Ahmed al-Sharaa, formerly known as Abu Mohammed al-Julani, has assumed the presidency of Syria. In a recent interview, he outlined his ambition to transition the nation toward a modern democracy while restoring its damaged international relationships and economy. He also emphasized his success in resolving tensions with the Kurdish community and stated that Syria will remain neutral regarding conflicts in Lebanon.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 መጨረሻ የአል-አሳድ አገዛዝ ከወደቀ በኋላ፣ ቀደም ሲል በአቡ መሐመድ አል-ጁላኒ ስም የሚታወቁት አህመድ አል-ሻራ የሶሪያ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው ተሹመዋል። በቅርቡ ባደረጉት ቃለ ምልልስ፣ አገሪቱን ወደ ዘመናዊ ዲሞክራሲ የመቀየር፣ የተጎዳውን ኢኮኖሚ የማገገም እና የውጭ ግንኙነቶችን የማሻሻል እቅዳቸውን አብራርተዋል። ከኩርድ ማህበረሰብ ጋር የነበረውን ግጭት በመፍታታቸው የተደሰቱ ሲሆን፣ ሶሪያ በሊባኖስ ግጭት ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንደማትገባም አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dhuma bara 2024 sirni al-Assad erga kufee booda, namni kanaan dura Abu Mohammadi al-Julaanii jedhamanii beekaman Ahmed al-Sharaa pirezidaantii Sooriyaa ta’aniiru. Gaafii fi deebii taasisaniin, biyyattii gara dimokiraasii ammayyaatti ceesisuu, dinagdee miidhame suphuu fi hariiroo idil-addunyaa foyyeessuuf karoorasanii akka jiran ibsaniiru. Haawaasa Kurdii wajjin walitti bu'iinsa ture furuu isaanii kan ibsan yoo ta'u, Sooriyaan walitti bu'iinsa Liibaanoos keessatti harka akka hin qabaanne mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Kushner to visit Israel after Netanyahu rejects Gaza Board of Peace plan
english: Jared Kushner is planning to travel to Israel and Egypt alongside senior officials to discuss a U.S.-backed peace proposal for Gaza. This trip follows Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s rejection of the plan, specifically opposing terms that require Hamas to disarm and Israeli troops to withdraw. Despite the current impasse, international mediators and the Board of Peace remain focused on building a roadmap to finalize the agreement.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በጋዛ ቀጣይነት ያለው ሰላም ለማምጣት በአሜሪካ የሚደገፈውን የሰላም እቅድ ለመወያየት እስራኤል እና ግብፅ እንደሚሄዱ ተገልጿል። ይህ ጉብኝት የተዘጋጀው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሃማስን ትጥቅ መፍታት እና የእስራኤል ጦር ከጋዛ መውጣትን የሚያካትተውን እቅድ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የኔታንያሁ መንግስት እቅዱን ቢቃወምም፣ አለም አቀፍ አደራዳሪዎች እና የሰላም ቦርድ አባላት ስምምነቱን ለማሳካት የጋራ መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Jared Kushner fi ogeeyyonni gurguddoon biroo karoora nageenyaa Gaazaaf qophaa'e irratti mari'achuuf gara Israa'el fi Misir akka imalan beekameera. Imalli kun kan qophaa'e muummichi ministeeraa Benjamin Netanyahu, gareen Hamas meeshaa waraanaa akka hiikuu fi waraanni Israa'el gaaza keessaa akka ba'u kan dirqisiisu karoora nageenyaa kana mormuu isaanii hordofee dha. Mootummaan Israa'el karoora kana mormus, walitti-fideeleen idil-addunyaa fi koreen nageenyaa waliigaltee kana milkeessuuf karaa furmaataa barbaadaa jiru.

title: Mutual defence: The alliances that preceded Turkiye-Pakistan-Saudi pact
english: Turkiye, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia have established a new mutual defense pact that treats an attack on one member as an attack on all, mirroring NATO's collective defense principle. This alliance aims to strengthen military cooperation through joint exercises and deeper industrial partnerships amidst rising regional tensions. The agreement, which involves high-level coordination between defense and political officials, is also open for other nations to join in the future.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ፓኪስታን እና ሳውዲ አረቢያ በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሶስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ የሚቆጠርበት አዲስ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ጥምረት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ ችግር ለመቋቋም፣ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን እና የጦር መሣሪያ ኢንዱስትሪ ትብብርን ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። ስምምነቱ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ እና የፖለቲካ ባለስልጣናትን የሚያሳትፍ ሲሆን፣ ወደፊት ሌሎች ሀገራትም እንዲቀላቀሉበት ክፍት መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Turkiin, Paakistaanii fi Sa'udii Arabiyaan waliigaltee ittisaa haaraa kanneen keessaa tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatame hundasaanii irratti raawwatamee akka lakkaa'amu ibsu mallatteessaniiru. Walta'iinsi kun naannichatti rakkoolee nageenyaa mudataa jiranuuf deebii kennuuf, leenjii waraanaa waliinii fi guddina indaastirii ittisaa waliin cimsuuf kan karoorfame dha. Waliigalteen kun qondaaltota waraanaa fi siyaasaa sadarkaa olaanaa irratti argaman kan wal qunnamsiisu yoo ta'u, gara fuulduraatti biyyoonni biroon akka itti makamanis karaa banaa dha.

title: ‘De facto annexation’: Israel to shift civilian enforcement in West Bank from army to police
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has ordered a plan to transition civilian law enforcement in the occupied West Bank from military to police authority. This policy shift aims to allow the army to focus exclusively on security and counter-terrorism, while police manage civil matters as they do within Israel. Critics view this move as a step toward the de facto annexation of the territory.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የሲቪል ህግ ማስከበር ስራን ከጦር ሰራዊት ወደ ፖሊስ የሚያሸጋግር እቅድ እንዲዘጋጅ አዘዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ጦሩ በፀጥታ እና በሽብርተኝነት ላይ ብቻ እንዲያተኩር ለማድረግ ያለመ ሲሆን ፖሊስ ደግሞ የሲቪል ጉዳዮችን እንዲመራ ያደርጋል። ተቺዎች ይህ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ግዛቷን ለመቀላቀል የሚደረግ ግልጽ እንቅስቃሴ ነው ሲሉ ይተቹታል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, qindoomina seeraa naannoo Weest Baankiin to'annoo waraanaa jala jiru gara humna poolisiitti jijjiiruuf karoora akka qopha'u ajajaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun waraanni bakka tokko irratti xiyyeeffatee akka hojjetuuf yoo ta'u, poolisiin ammoo dhimmoota siivilii akka to'atu taasisa. Warri yaada kana morman, tarkaanfiin kun qabeenya biyyattii ofitti makachuuf karaa saaquudha jechuun ibsaniiru.

title: Kushner to visit Israel to discuss Trump's Gaza plan
english: Jared Kushner is traveling to Israel and Egypt to discuss a peace proposal for Gaza that was recently rejected by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The U.S. envoy aims to address concerns regarding the plan, which suggests Hamas disarm in exchange for a phased Israeli troop withdrawal. Despite ongoing tensions and military strikes, American officials remain focused on achieving the goal of a demilitarized Gaza.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በቅርቡ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ውድቅ የተደረገውን የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ ለመወያየት ወደ እስራኤል እና ግብፅ ያቀናሉ። የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ዕቅዱን በተመለከተ ያሉ ስጋቶችን ለመፍታት እና ሃማስ ትጥቁን እንዲፈታ በመጠየቅ የሰላም ሂደቱን ለማስቀጠል ይሞክራሉ። ምንም እንኳን በጋዛ ግጭቶች እና ጥቃቶች ቢቀጥሉም፣ አሜሪካ የጋዛን ትጥቅ ማስፈታት ዋና ግብ አድርጋ ትቀጥላለች።
oromo: Jaared Kushner karoora nagaa Gaazaatiif bahe kan muummicha ministeeraa Benjaamin Netaanyaahuun mormame irratti mari'achuuf gara Israa'el fi Gibxii imaluuf qophaa'aa jira. Ergamaan Ameerikaa kun yaaddoo dhiyaate irratti mari'achuun, gareen Hamaas hidhannoo hiikatee waraanni Israa'el akka gadi lakkisu taasisuuf carraaqqii godha. Giddu galeessa weeraraa fi walitti bu'iinsa ammaas, Ameerikaan Gaazaa hidhannoo hiiksisuun nagaa buusuuf xiyyeeffannoo kenniteetti.

title: ‘De facto annexation’: Israel to shift civilian enforcement in West Bank from army to police
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has ordered a plan to transfer civilian law enforcement in the occupied West Bank from the military to the police. This shift aims to allow the army to focus exclusively on security and counter-terrorism, while police handle civilian matters as they do within Israel. Critics and observers suggest this move effectively treats the territory like an integrated part of Israel, furthering the process of de facto annexation.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የሲቪል ህግ ማስከበር ስራን ከወታደራዊ ኃይሉ ወደ ፖሊስ ለማዛወር የሚያስችል እቅድ አዘዋል። ይህ ለውጥ ወታደራዊው ኃይል በፀጥታ እና በአሸባሪነት ላይ ብቻ እንዲያተኩር ሲያግዝ፣ ፖሊስ ደግሞ እንደሌሎች የእስራኤል አካባቢዎች የሲቪል ጉዳዮችን እንዲቆጣጠር ያስችለዋል። ተቺዎች ይህ አካሄድ ግዛቱን እንደ እስራኤል አካል ለማድረግ ያለመ እና ትክክለኛው የይገባኛል ጥያቄን የሚያጠናክር እርምጃ ነው ሲሉ ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, hojiin nageenyaa fi seera kabachiisuu naannoo Weest Baank keessatti waraana harkaa gara poolisitti akka darbu ajajaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun waraanni xiyyeeffannaa isaa qofaa nageenyaa fi shororkeessummaa ittisuurratti akka godhatuufi, poolisiin immoo akka Israa'el keessaatti dhimmoota siviilii akka to'atuuf gargaara. Qeeqtonni tarkaanfiin kun naannicha guutummaatti biyyattii keessatti akka hammamuufi, dhugumaan biyya ofii godhachuu (annexation) akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Video: Israel Katz inaugurates illegal new settlement in Jenin
english: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz officially opened a new settlement in Jenin on Thursday. This action took place immediately following the destruction of Palestinian-owned businesses and properties in the area. The establishment of this settlement is considered illegal under international law.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ ሐሙስ ዕለት በጀኒን አዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ መክፈታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዚያው አካባቢ የፍልስጤም ንብረት የሆኑ ሱቆችን እና ሌሎች ግንባታዎችን ካፈረሱ በኋላ ነው። ይህ የአዲስ ሰፈራ ግንባታ በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት ህገ-ወጥ ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz guyyaa Kamisaa magaalaa Jeeniin keessatti qubannaa haaraa seeraan alaa ta'e tokko eebbisuun bananiiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraanni Israa'el qabeenyaa fi suuqiiwwan warra Falasxiin erga diiganii booda dha. Hundeeffamni qubannaa kanaa seera idil-addunyaatiin kan hin hayyamamne fi seeraan alaa dha.

title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta crisis with paid advice for help to cross
english: A BBC investigation has uncovered a network of Instagram accounts that are misleading migrants by portraying the dangerous swim from Morocco to the Spanish enclave of Ceuta as an easy and safe journey. These accounts target vulnerable individuals with promotional content and demand hundreds of pounds in exchange for deceptive advice on how to cross the border. This activity has significantly contributed to a massive surge in migration, ignoring the reality that many people have tragically drowned while attempting these illegal routes.
amharic: የቢቢሲ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው ከሞሮኮ ወደ ስፓኒሽ ግዛት ሱታ በባህር የሚደረገውን አደገኛ ጉዞ ቀላል እና አስተማማኝ አድርገው የሚያሳዩ የኢንስታግራም አካውንቶች ተበራክተዋል። እነዚህ አካውንቶች ሰዎችን በማታለል ድንበር እንዴት ማቋረጥ እንደሚቻል የሐሰት ምክር ለመስጠት ከሰዎች ከፍተኛ ገንዘብ ይጠይቃሉ። ይህ ድርጊት በርካታ ሰዎች አደገኛውን መንገድ እንዲመርጡ በማድረግ ለሞት እና ለከባድ አደጋ እየዳረጋቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC akka agarsiisutti, imala balaa qabu kan Marookoo irraa gara magaalaa Ceuta jedhamtuutti namoonni daakuun ce'uun salphaa fi nageenya kan qabu ta'uu ibsuun olola sobaa babal'isu. Gareen kun namoota gowwoomsuun daangaa ce'uuf gorsa sobaa kennuudhaan maallaqa hedduu gaafatu. Gochi kun namoonni hedduun karaa balaa qabu kana akka filatan gochuudhaan lubbuun isaanii akka darbuufi miidhaa hamaa irra akka ga'an sababa ta'eera.

title: Builders unearth €9m gold loot sealed in walls of Belgian property
english: Construction workers renovating a home in Belgium recently discovered a massive stash of gold bars and coins worth approximately 9 million euros hidden inside the basement walls. The treasure was found during plumbing work, and the site is now under police protection while officials investigate who will legally own the findings. The property is currently owned by a charity, and under Belgian law, there is a five-year window for any potential rightful owners to come forward.
amharic: በቤልጂየም ውስጥ የቤቱን መሠረት በመጠገን ላይ የነበሩ ሠራተኞች በቤቱ ግድግዳ ውስጥ ተደብቆ የነበረ ዘጠኝ ሚሊዮን ዩሮ የሚያወጣ የወርቅ ሀብት አግኝተዋል። የወርቅ ብረቶችና ሳንቲሞቹ የተገኙት የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃ ቱቦዎችን ሲቀብሩ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የወርቅ ሀብቱ በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የቤቱ ባለቤት የሆነው በጎ አድራጊ ድርጅት ሀብቱ ለበጎ ስራ እንዲውል ተስፋ ሲያደርግ፣ የቤልጂየም ህግ ደግሞ ትክክለኛ ባለቤቱ ሀብቱን ለመጠየቅ የአምስት ዓመት ጊዜ እንደሚሰጥ ይደነግጋል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni ijaarsa mana tokko Beljiyeem keessatti suphuuf ture, dallaa mana sanaa keessatti warqee gatiin isaa yeroo ammaa Yuuroo miliyoona 9 ta'u argatan. Warqeen kun kan argame yeroo isaanii boorii bishaan fa'ii itti qopheessaa turanitti yommuu ta'u, amma qabeenyichi poolisiin eegamaa jira. title: Pakistan PM’s ‘red line’ warning to India over water treaty
english: Pakistan's Prime Minister, Shehbaz Sharif, has issued a stern warning to India, describing the country's water resources as a critical boundary that must not be crossed. He accused the Indian government of violating the Indus Waters Treaty and declared that Pakistan is prepared to address any future provocations. This statement highlights the ongoing diplomatic friction between the two nations following their military conflict in May 2025.

oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Paakistaan Shehbaz Sharif mootummaa Indiyaarratti akeekkachiisa cimaa kennaniiru. Qabeenya bishaan biyyattii akka sarara diimaa (red line) kan ibsan yoo ta'u, Indiyaan waliigaltee bishaan Indus seeraan ala cabsiti jiru jechuun himataniiru. Paakistaan rakkoolee gara fuulduraatti mudachuu danda'an kamiyyuu akka deebistu kan ibsan yoo ta'u, haasaan kun waldhabdee waggaa 2025 waraana booda biyyoota lamaan gidduutti uumame kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Russia stance will be defended in court, pledges World Athletics chief Coe
english: World Athletics President Sebastian Coe has vowed to personally defend the organization's ongoing ban on Russian and Belarusian athletes at the Court of Arbitration for Sport. The Russian athletics federation is legally challenging the sanctions, arguing they are politically motivated and unfair. Despite other sports bodies relaxing their rules, Coe insists the ban is necessary to protect the integrity of competition rather than being a political statement.
amharic: የዓለም አትሌቲክስ ፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ሴባስቲያን ኮ፣ ድርጅታቸው በሩሲያ እና በቤላሩስ አትሌቶች ላይ የጣለውን እገዳ በስፖርት የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ሰጪ አካል (CAS) ፊት እንደሚከላከሉ አስታውቀዋል። የሩሲያ አትሌቲክስ ፌዴሬሽን እገዳው ፖለቲካዊ እና ኢ-ፍትሃዊ ነው በሚል ክስ አቅርቧል። ሆኖም ኮ፣ ይህ ውሳኔ ከፖለቲካ የጸዳ እና የውድድሩን ታማኝነት ለመጠበቅ ታስቦ የተወሰደ እርምጃ እንደሆነ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Waldaa Atileetiksii Addunyaa Sebaastiyaan Koween, dorgomtoota Raashiyaa fi Beelaarus irratti dhorkaan kaa'ame akka itti fufu mana murtii jijjiirraa ispoortiitti akka dhaga'amu waadaa galaniiru. Waldaan atileetiksii Raashiyaa dhorkaan kun siyaasa irratti hundaa'e jechuun mormii kaaseera. Haa ta'u malee, Koween dhorkaan kun siyaasa osoo hin taane qulqullina fi amanamummaa dorgommii eeguuf kan fudhatame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: US missionary kidnapped in Niger released after nine months in captivity
english: Kevin Rideout, an American pilot working for a missionary group, has been freed after being held captive for over nine months in Niger. He was abducted by armed men in Niamey last October and is now in the custody of U.S. officials. While specific details regarding his release remain undisclosed, reports suggest he was held by a militant group active in the region.
amharic: ኬቨን ራይድአውት የተባሉ አሜሪካዊ ሚስዮናዊ በኒጀር ታግተው ከዘጠኝ ወራት በላይ ከቆዩ በኋላ በሰላም ተለቀቁ። ባለፈው ጥቅምት ወር በኒያሜ በታጣቂዎች ተጠልፈው የነበሩት አብራሪው፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ቁጥጥር ስር ይገኛሉ። ስለ መለቀቃቸው ዝርዝር መረጃ ባይኖርም፣ በአካባቢው በሚንቀሳቀስ ታጣቂ ቡድን ተይዘው እንደነበር ይገመታል።
oromo: Pilaotii Ameerikaa kan ta'an Kevin Rideout, erga ji'oota sagalii ol biyya Niijaritti butamanii turanii booda nagaatti gadhiifaman. Namni kun darbe Caamsaa keessa magaalaa Niyaameetti hidhattootaan butamanii kan turan yoo ta'u, amma harka mootummaa Ameerikaatti argamu. Haala itti gadhiifaman ilaalchisee odeeffannoon bal'aan hin kennamne malee, hidhattoota naannichatti socho'an harka akka turan ni himama.

title: Saudi Arabia announces start of Red Sea defence alliance: Will it work?
english: Saudi Arabia has officially launched a new multinational maritime defense alliance involving 13 countries to protect key shipping routes in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. Member nations plan to enhance regional security by sharing intelligence, conducting joint naval exercises, and coordinating military operations. While 13 nations have completed the formal process, more countries are expected to join this open coalition in the near future.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በቀይ ባህር እና በአደን ባህረ ሰላጤ አካባቢ የሚደረገውን የንግድ መርከቦች ጉዞ ለመጠበቅ 13 አገራት ያካተተ አዲስ የባህር ኃይል ጥምረት በይፋ መስርታለች። የአባል አገራቱ የመረጃ ልውውጥ በማድረግ፣ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን በማካሄድ እና የባህር ላይ ስራዎችን በማስተባበር የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ አቅደዋል። ይህ ጥምረት ለሌሎች አገራትም ክፍት በመሆኑ ተጨማሪ አባላት በቅርቡ እንደሚቀላቀሉት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan qaxxaamura galaanaa iddoo baqqaana Bab al-Mandeb, Galaana Diimaa fi Galaana Adeniitti nageenya geejjiba galaanaa eeguuf biyyoota 13 of keessatti hammate walta’iinsa humna galaanaa haaraa hundeesiteetti. Biyyoonni miseensa ta’an odeeffannoo waljijjiiruun, leenjii waraanaa waloo gaggeessuun akkasumas hojiiwwan galaanaa waliin qindeesuun nageenya naannichaa eeguuf karoorfataniiru. Walta’iinsi kun biyyoota biroofis kan baname waan ta’eef, gara fuulduraatti biyyoonni biroon itti makamu jedhamee eegama.

title: Iraq says daily oil exports at highest level since start of war
english: Iraq's oil ministry announced that daily oil exports have reached two million barrels since the start of August. This marks the highest export volume recorded since the regional conflict involving Iran and the U.S. began affecting the Strait of Hormuz. These figures highlight a significant recovery in Iraq's oil trade despite ongoing geopolitical tensions.

oromo: Ministeerri boba'aa Iraaq akka ibsetti, jalqaba ji'a Hagayyaa irraa eegalee biyyattiin guyyaatti boba'aa miliyoona lama gabaa biyya alaa ergaa jirti. Kunis, waraanni Iran fi Ameerikaa gidduutti ka'eefi buufata Hormuz cufuun isaa erga jalqabee as, gabaa kana keessatti sadarkaa ol aanaa dha. Lakkoofsi kun rakkoolee siyaasaa naannichatti jiran keessa iyyuu, daldalli boba'aa Iraaq fooyya'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: AIPAC spent millions to unseat me. Here’s why they’re now losing: Ex-congressman | Jamaal Bowman
english: Former Congressman Jamaal Bowman claims that the lobbying group AIPAC spent significant funds to remove him from office. Despite these efforts, he argues that the influence of such organizations is beginning to decline. Bowman believes that his experience highlights a growing shift in political sentiments regarding how outside groups impact election outcomes.

oromo: Miseensi koongresii duraanii Jamaal Bowmaan, gareen dhiibbaa uumu AIPAC jedhamu isa aangoo irraa buusuuf maallaqa guddaa akka baase ibsaniiru. Bowmaan muuxannoon isaa kun jijjiirama siyaasaa fi dhiibbaan gareewwan alaa bu'aa filannoo irratti qaban xiqqachaa akka dhufe akka mul'isu amanu.

title: Iran formalises Strait of Hormuz control as US struggles to sustain war it launched with Israel
english: Iran's parliament has taken initial steps toward implementing a strategic plan that would grant the country greater control over the Strait of Hormuz. Under these new regulations, Iran intends to block maritime traffic from nations it views as adversaries, specifically the United States and Israel. This move comes as regional tensions remain high and the US faces difficulties managing the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East.

oromo: Paarlaamaan Iraan daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz irratti to'annoo cimaa gochuuf karoora tarsiimawaa ta'e tokko raggaasiseera. Karoora kanaan, Iraan biyyoota akka Ameerikaa fi Israa'el kanneen isheen diina jette amantuuf qaxxaamura galaanichaa dhorkuuf karoorfateetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo waldhabdeen naannichaa hammaatee fi Ameerikaan rakkoowwan naannoo kanaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa keessa jirtutti.

title: 'Mayfair means money': A walk through the Gulf elite's favourite part of London
english: Dubai's ruler, Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, faced public protests during his visit to London over the UAE's alleged role in the war in Sudan. The confrontation occurred near a luxury shopping district in Mayfair, an area popular with wealthy Gulf residents and investors. While some visitors from the UAE defend their government's actions, the incident highlights the ongoing tensions surrounding foreign involvement in the Sudanese conflict.
amharic: የዱባዩ ገዢ መሐመድ ቢን ራሺድ አል ማክቱም ለንደን በነበራቸው ቆይታ፣ የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች በሱዳን ጦርነት ውስጥ እጃቸው አለበት በሚል በዜጎች ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ይህ ክስተት የተፈጠረው በበርካታ የባህረ ሰላጤው ሃገራት ባለጸጎች መኖሪያ በሆነችው ሜይፌር በተባለ የቅንጦት አካባቢ ነው። ከኤምሬቶች የመጡ አንዳንድ ጎብኚዎች የሃገራቸውን ድርጊት ቢከላከሉም፣ ይህ ಘಟನೆ በሱዳን ግጭት ውስጥ የውጭ ሃይሎች ጣልቃ ገብነት እያስከተለ ያለውን ውዝግብ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Bulchaan Dubaay, Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, yeroo London daawwatanitti waraana Sudaan keessatti gahee UAE qabduun walqabatee mormiifi balaaleffannaan isaan mudateera. Mormiin kun kan mudate naannoo Mayfair kan dureeyyoonni biyyoota Gulf itti boqotanitti. Namoonni UAE irraa dhufan tokko tokko gocha mootummaa isaanii kan ittisan yoo ta'u, taateen kun immoo gowwummaa fi waldhabdee waraana Sudaan keessatti hirmaannaa alagaa waliin walqabatee jiru ifa godheera.

title: Israeli soldiers prevent aid delivery to besieged Palestinians
english: Israeli military forces have blocked humanitarian activists from reaching Palestinian residents in the West Bank village of Qusra. These villagers have been effectively trapped in their homes by local settlers for almost a week. Efforts to provide essential aid to the besieged community have been unsuccessful due to the military intervention.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያንን ለመርዳት የሄዱ አክቲቪስቶችን አግደዋል። መንደሩ ለሳምንት ያህል በአካባቢው ሰፋሪዎች ተከቦ ነዋሪዎቹ ከቤታቸው እንዳይወጡ ተደርገዋል። በወታደሮቹ ጣልቃ ገብነት ምክንያት አስፈላጊውን እርዳታ ለተከበቡት ነዋሪዎች ማድረስ አልተቻለም።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el gargaarsa namoomaa gara baadiyaa Qusraa kan West Bankitti argamu geessuuf yaalii ta'e ugguranii jiru. Jiraattoonni baadiyaa kanaa torban tokkoof godaantota naannichaan marfamanii mana isaanii keessatti haala rakkoo keessa jiru. Duula kana sababeeffachuun, waraanni kun gargaarsa barbaachisaa ta'e jiraattota marfaman kanaaf akka hin geenye dhorkanii jiru.

title: Israeli forces block activists from reaching besieged Qusra families
english: Israeli forces have blocked activists from delivering essential food and water to around 15 Palestinians, including children, who have been trapped in their homes by settlers in the West Bank town of Qusra for nearly a week. The military declared the area a closed zone and removed international aid workers, leaving the residents without electricity or water. Fearing their property will be seized, the families have refused orders to abandon their homes despite ongoing harassment from settlers.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች ለሳምንት ያህል በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ ከተማ የታገዱ 15 ፍልስጤማውያን (ህጻናትን ጨምሮ) እርዳታ እንዳይደርስላቸው ከልክለዋል። ሰራዊቱ አካባቢውን የተከለከለ ወታደራዊ ቀጠና በማወጅ አጋዥ ሰራተኞችን ከቦታው ያባረረ ሲሆን ቤተሰቦቹም ያለ ውሃ እና ኤሌክትሪክ እንዲቆዩ ተገደዋል። ነዋሪዎቹ ቤታቸውን እንዳያጡ በመስጋት ወታደሮቹ ቦታውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ የሰጡትን ትእዛዝ ለመቀበል ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el maatiiwwan Palesxinaa 15 ta'an, kanneen ijoollee dabalatu, magaala Qusraa keessatti torban tokkoof qubattoota Israa'eliin marfamanii jiranuf gargaarsa nyaataa fi bishaanii akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el naannicha bakka waraanaa cufaa ta'e jechuun gargaartota alaa ari'eera, kunis maatiiwwan kun ibsaa fi bishaan malee akka hafan godheera. Maatiiwwan kunneen manni isaanii akka hin fudhatamne sodaachuun, ajaja naannicha gadi lakkisanii akka bahaniif kenname didaniiru.

title: Rising Australian golfer Bang dies of brain haemorrhage in Thailand aged 18
english: Rising Australian professional golfer Jessica Bang has passed away at the age of 18 following a brain haemorrhage. She collapsed while in Thailand to compete in a qualifying tournament and failed to recover after undergoing emergency surgery. The golf community and her family are mourning the loss of the talented teenager who recently celebrated her first professional victory.
amharic: አውስትራሊያዊቷ ታዳጊ ፕሮፌሽናል ጎልፍ ተጫዋች ጀሲካ ባንግ በአንጎል ደም መፍሰስ ምክንያት በ18 ዓመቷ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለየች። በታይላንድ ውድድር ላይ ለመሳተፍ ተዘጋጅታ በነበረችበት ወቅት በድንገት በመውደቋ በአስቸኳይ ቀዶ ጥገና ተደርጎላት ነበር። ሆኖም ህይወቷን ማትረፍ ባለመቻሏ የጎልፍ ስፖርት ቤተሰቦች እና ቤተሰቦቿ በታላቅ ሀዘን ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Taphattuun golfii Ostraaliyaa beekamtii argachaa turte Jessica Bang, dhibee dhiiga sammuu keessatti dhangala'uun umurii waggaa 18tti du'uun ishee dhaga'ameera. Isheen erga Taayilaanditti dorgommii golfiif qophaa'aa jirtuu tasa kukkuftee booda, baqaqsanii hodhuu (surgery) hatattamaa erga godhamtee boodas lubbuun ishee darbeera. Hawwaasni ispoortii golfii fi maatiin ishee, dargaggeettii goota kanaa ta'e kana erga darbee booda gadda cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Huckabee calls Israeli settlers ‘terrorists’: Can US push end Qusra siege?
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has taken a rare and firm stance by labeling Israeli settlers who besieged three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra as terrorists. The settlers had trapped the families, including a US citizen, cutting off essential supplies like water and electricity in an attempt to seize their property. Following US intervention, Israeli forces were deployed to remove the settlers, marking a significant and unusually strong condemnation of settler violence by a high-ranking US official.
amharic: የአሜሪካው የእስራኤል አምባሳደር ማይክ ሃካቢ በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ መንደር ሶስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን ከበው የነበሩ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎችን 'ሽብርተኞች' በማለት በአደባባይ ወቅሰዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ የአሜሪካ ዜግነት ያላቸውን ግለሰቦች ጨምሮ ቤተሰቦቹን ከውሃ እና ኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት በማቋረጥ መሬታቸውን ለመውረስ ጥረት ሲያደርጉ ነበር። የአሜሪካ መንግስት ባደረገው ግፊት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሰፋሪዎቹን ከቦታው እንዲወጡ ማድረጋቸው፣ የከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣን እንዲህ አይነት ጠንካራ ውግዘት ሲሰነዝሩ መታየቱ እጅግ ያልተለመደ ክስተት ሆኗል።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa gara Israa'elitti ergaman Maayik Haakabii, godina Weest Baank ganda Qusraa keessatti maatiiwwan Falasxiin sadii irratti weerara gaggeessaa turan qaxaleewwan Israa'el 'shororkeessitoota' jechuun balaaleffataniiru. Qaxaleewwan kunneen maatiiwwan Ameerikaa dabalatee jiran bakka tokkotti ugguruun, bishaanfi elektirikii dhaabuun qabeenya isaanii saamuuf yaalii godhaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa dhiibbaa waan godheef, waraanni Israa'el qaxaleewwan kana naannichaa akka gadi lakkisan gochuun isaanii, namni sadarkaa olaanaa irra jiru tokko gocha kana bifa kanaan balaaleffachuun isaa baay'ee kan nama ajaa'ibu ta'eera.

title: Russia's UN envoy says Hormuz navigation 'ruined' by US
english: Russian UN diplomat Mikhail Ulyanov has accused the United States of destabilizing the Strait of Hormuz through its aggressive stance toward Iran. He argues that Washington’s policies have undermined the freedom of navigation in the region rather than protecting it. Ulyanov claims that the U.S. is now attempting to resolve the resulting regional tension by escalating conflict, which he describes as a flawed strategic approach.
amharic: የሩሲያ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ተወካይ ሚካሂል ኡሊያኖቭ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገው ጠበኛ አካሄድ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ ያለውን የባህር ጉዞ ነፃነት እንዳናጋው ተችተዋል። ዋሽንግተን የባህር ጉዞ ነፃነትን እፈልጋለሁ ብትልም፣ በራሷ ስህተት የፈጠረችውን ቀውስ በጦርነት ለመፍታት መሞከሯ ተገቢ አለመሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ዲፕሎማቱ የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ስትራቴጂያዊ ስህተት የተሞላበት መሆኑን ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Bakka bu'aan Raashiyaa kan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa Mikhail Ulyanov, Amerikaan gara Iraniitti kan qabdu tarkaanfii cimaan kun karaa galaana Hormuz irratti tasgabbii dhabsiiseera jechuun komataniiru. Washington bilisummaa daandii galaana sanaa kabachiisuu barbaaddus, rakkoon amma uumame sun dogoggora kanaan dura isheen raawwatte irraa kan dhufe ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ulyanov, Amerikaan dogoggora ofii ishee sirreessuuf jecha waraana babal'isuun filannoo sirrii miti jechuun cimsanii balaaleffataniiru.

title: Palestinians in West Bank village remain under Israeli settler siege for sixth day
english: Palestinian families in the village of Qusra have been trapped for nearly a week as Israeli settlers occupy the area around their homes. The settlers have disrupted essential services like water and electricity, effectively isolating the residents. Although the Israeli military is present in the area, they have reportedly failed to intervene, leaving the families without access to necessary food or medical supplies.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች ቤታቸውን በመክበባቸው ላለፉት ስድስት ቀናት በከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ሰፋሪዎቹ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦቶችን በመቁረጣቸው ነዋሪዎቹ የምግብ እና የሕክምና ዕርዳታ ማግኘት ተስኗቸዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደሮች አካባቢው ቢደርሱም፣ ሰፋሪዎቹን ከማስወገድ ይልቅ አብረዋቸው ሲታዩ በመታየቱ ቤተሰቦቹ አሁንም በከፍተኛ አደጋ ውስጥ ናቸው።
oromo: Maatiin Falasxiin kan baadiyyaa Qusra jiraatan, guyyoota ja’an darbanif naannoo manasaaniitti marsaa qonnaan bultoota Israa’el jalatti kufanii jiru. Qonnaan bultoonni kunneen bishaanifi elektirikii irraa kutuun, maatiiwwan kun nyaataafi qoricha argachuu akka hin dandeenye godhaniiru. Waraanni Israa’el bakka sana kan gahan ta’us, qonnaan bultoota kana achi baasuun hafee isaan wajjiin yeroo dabarsaa waan jiraniif, maatiiwwan kun rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Iran formalises Strait of Hormuz control as US struggles to sustain war it launched with Israel
english: Iran has officially moved toward controlling the Strait of Hormuz by approving a strategic plan that allows it to block ships from nations it considers hostile, including the US and Israel. This development comes as the US threatens to impose historic economic sanctions to counter Tehran's influence in this critical energy corridor. Meanwhile, Iran is actively seeking to bypass these pressures by pursuing deeper ties with international financial groups like the Brics-backed New Development Bank.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝን የባህር በር ለመቆጣጠር የሚያስችል ስልታዊ እቅድ በማጽደቅ፣ እንደ አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ያሉ ጠላት ብላ የምትፈርጃቸው አገራት መርከቦች ወደ አካባቢው እንዳይገቡ ከልክላለች። ይህ እርምጃ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ስታስፈራራበት በነበረበት ወቅት የተከናወነ ነው። በምላሹም ኢራን በአሜሪካ ከሚመሩ የፋይናንስ ተቋማት ውጪ አማራጭ የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነቶችን ለመፍጠር ከብሪክስ አገራት ጋር በቅርበት እየሰራች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Iiraan daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz to'achuuf karoora tarsiimawaa raggaasisteetti; kunis biyyoota akka Ameerikaa fi Israa'el kanneen diina ishee ta'an jedhamanirraa markaboonni daandicha fayyadamuu akka hin dandeenye kan taasisuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo Ameerikaan Iiraanirratti tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhachuuf doorsisaa jirtutti. Gama biraatiin, Iiraan dhiibbaa kana dandamachuuf jecha, dhaabbilee faayinaansii addunyaa kan akka New Development Bank kan Brics waliin hariiroo cimaa uummachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirti.

title: Man City tight-lipped on Rodri transfer amid Barcelona and Real Madrid link
english: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca has declined to clarify the future of midfielder Rodri amid growing transfer rumors involving Barcelona and Real Madrid. Speculation intensified after Rodri was photographed on a flight from Madrid to England, though reports suggest Real Madrid may be priced out of a potential move. Maresca emphasized that while the transfer window remains active, his primary focus is preparing the team for the upcoming Community Shield match against Arsenal.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ሲቲው አሰልጣኝ ኢንዞ ማሬስካ ከባርሴሎና እና ሪያል ማድሪድ ጋር ስሙ የተያያዘው አማካዩ ሮድሪ ስለሚኖረው የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ግልጽ መግለጫ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል። የዝውውር መስኮቱ ክፍት በመሆኑ ማንኛውም ነገር ሊከሰት እንደሚችል የገለጹት አሰልጣኙ፣ ሮድሪ ከማድሪድ ወደ እንግሊዝ ሲጓዝ መታየቱ ውዝግብ ቢፈጥርም ትኩረታቸው አርሰናልን በሚገጥሙበት የኮሚዩኒቲ ሺልድ ጨዋታ ላይ ብቻ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ሮድሪ ከቀዶ ጥገና በኋላ ወደ ልምምድ የተመለሰ ቢሆንም ስለ ዝውውሩ እስካሁን የተረጋገጠ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Leenjisaan Manchestir Siti Inzo Maareskaa, gabaasota gabaa dabarsuu keessatti maqaan Roordirii ka'aa jiru ilaalchisee yaada kennuu irraa of qusataniiru. Roordiriin Maadiriid irraa gara Ingilizitti osoo deemaa jiruu kaameraan qabamuun isaa shakkii guddaa uumee kan jiru yoo ta'u, Maareskaan garuu xiyyeeffannaan isaa guutuu tapha kaappii 'Community Shield' kan Arsenal wajjin taphatamu irratti akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Gabaasni tokko tokko akka ibsanitti, gatiin gabaa taphatichaa ሪያል Maadiriid dura dhabuu danda'a jedhamee yaadama.

title: US threatens ‘indefinite’ blockade against Iran: How long can it last?
english: The United States has pledged to maintain an indefinite naval blockade on Iran and plans to implement unprecedented economic sanctions to isolate the country. Despite US claims of control, the Strait of Hormuz remains closed by Iranian authorities, effectively halting maritime traffic in the area. Meanwhile, there are growing internal concerns regarding the well-being of American sailors stationed on the USS Abraham Lincoln due to the prolonged deployment.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአይራን ላይ የጣለችውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ እንደምትቀጥል እና አገሪቱን ለማግለል ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል አስታውቃለች። የአሜሪካ መንግስት የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደቆጣጠረ ቢገልጽም፣ ኢራን በአሁኑ ወቅት የባህር መስመሩን ዘግታ በመያዟ በዚያ አካባቢ የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ተቋርጧል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ረጅም ጊዜ በፈጀው ዘመቻ ምክንያት በአሜሪካ የጦር መርከብ ላይ ያሉ መርከበኞች የጤና እና የደህንነት ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Amerikaa qarqara galaana Iranitti kan kuffiste ugguraa galaanaa gara fuulduraatti yeroo hin murtoofneef akka itti fufsiistu fi Iran addunyaa irraa addaan baasuuf tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhachuuf karoorfatteetti. Mootummaan Amerikaa daandii galaana Hormuz to’annaa isaa jala akka jiru ibsuus, Iran daandii sana cuftee waan jirtuuf sochiin dooniiwwanii adda citee jira. Gama biraatiin, yeroo dheeraa fudhachuu duula kanaatiin walqabatee haalli jireenyaa fi nageenyaa loltoota doonii Amerikaa ‘USS Abraham Lincoln’ irra jiran yaaddoo keessa seenee jira.

title: Russian ballistic attacks intensify as Kyiv claims Dnipropetrovsk advance
english: Ukraine has successfully recaptured 26 settlements in the Dnipropetrovsk region, regaining control over significant territory from Russian forces. Despite this military progress, Russia has ramped up its missile and drone attacks on major Ukrainian cities, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. The ongoing conflict remains intense as Ukraine struggles to defend against these strikes while continuing its counteroffensive operations.
amharic: ዩክሬን በዲኒፕሮፔትሮቭስክ ክልል 26 ሰፈሮችን በተሳካ ሁኔታ መልሳ መቆጣጠር ችላለች። ይህ ወታደራዊ ስኬት ቢኖርም ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ዋና ዋና ከተሞች ላይ የሚሰነዝረውን የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃት አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች። ጥቃቱ በዜጎች ላይ ጉዳት እና በታችኛው መዋቅር ላይ ውድመት እያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ ዩክሬን በአንድ በኩል የመልሶ ማጥቃት ዘመቻዋን በሌላ በኩል የራሷን መከላከያ ለማጠናከር እየታገለች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Yukireeniin naannoo Diiniiprooppetiroovsk keessatti ganda 26 irra deebitee to'annaa ishee jala galchiteetti. Milkaa'ina waraanaa kana ta'us, Raashiyaan magaalota gurguddoo Yukireen irratti rukuttaa mizaayilii fi doroniin raawwattu daran cimsiteetti, kunis miidhaa lubbuu fi mancaatii qabeenyaa geessiseera. Yukireeniin gama tokkoon lola ishee itti fufee fi gama biraan immoo miidhaa kana ofirraa ittisuuf qabsaa'aa jirti.

title: Record-breaking rain in Japan leaves several dead, thousands stranded
english: Historic rainfall in Japan's Chiba prefecture has led to severe flooding, resulting in at least four deaths and one missing person. Authorities have issued evacuation orders for over 400,000 residents as flood risks persist. Although the intense rain is subsiding, the region remains under alert for ongoing dangers.
amharic: በጃፓን ቺባ ግዛት የጣለው ከፍተኛ ዝናብ ባስከተለው የጎርፍ አደጋ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ አንድ ሰው ደግሞ የደረሰበት አይታወቅም። የጎርፍ አደጋው ስጋት በመቀጠሉ ከ400,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ ትዕዛዝ ተላልፏል። ምንም እንኳን ዝናቡ እየቀነሰ ቢመጣም፣ በክልሉ ያለው አደጋ አሁንም ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Bokkaan roobee hin beekne naannoo Chiibaa Jaappaaniitti roobeen balaa lolaa hammaataa fideen namoonni afur lubbuun isaanii darbeera, namni tokkos badeera. Balaan lolaa waan jiruuf namoota 400,000 ol ta'aniif ajajni gadi ba'uu kennameera. Goolli bokkaa hir'atuus, balaan lolaa naannichatti waan jiruuf of eeggannoon cimaan taasifamaa jira.

title: Palestinians in West Bank village remain under Israeli settler siege for sixth day
english: For six days, Palestinian families in the village of Qusra have been trapped in their homes due to a blockade by Israeli settlers. Despite an announced military operation, the settlers remain, and reports suggest that Israeli forces have instead restricted access to the area and taken over some private homes. The families are suffering from a lack of essential supplies like food, water, and electricity as the situation continues to escalate.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው ኩስራ መንደር የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች ከበባ ውስጥ ለስድስት ቀናት ቆይተዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር ሰፋሪዎችን ለማስወጣት ዘመቻ መጀመሩን ቢገልጽም፣ ሰፋሪዎቹ ቦታውን አልለቀቁም፤ እንዲያውም ወታደሮች አንዳንድ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን በመቆጣጠር ለነዋሪዎች የሚደርሰውን የእርዳታ አቅርቦት አግደዋል። በዚህም የተነሳ ተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ለምግብ፣ ለውሃ እና ለኤሌክትሪክ እጥረት ተዳርገው ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Maatiiwwan Falastiinii baadiyyaa Qusraa keessa jiraatan guyyaa ja'aaf marsaa qotee bultoota Israa'elii jala jiru. Waraanni Israa'el qotee bultoota kana achii ari'uuf duula jalqabne jedhee ibsee tureyyuu, isaan achi keessaa hin baane; kanaa mannaa waraanni Israa'el manneen jireenyaa tokko tokko to'annoo jala oolchuun gargaarsi akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru. Rakkoo kana hordofuunis maatiiwwan kun nyaataa fi bishaan dhabuun rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Video: Israel inaugurates new illegal settlement in Jenin
english: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz officially opened a new settlement in Jenin this Thursday. This action took place immediately following the destruction of several Palestinian businesses and properties by Israeli military forces in the same area. The move highlights escalating tensions regarding territorial expansion in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በዚህ ሳምንት ሐሙስ ዕለት በጀኒን አዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ መክፈታቸውን ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈጸመው የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዚያው አካባቢ የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ንግድ ቤቶችንና ንብረቶችን ካወደሙ በኋላ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የግዛት ማስፋፋት ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz guyyaa Kamisaa kana magaala Jenin keessatti qubannaa haaraa seeraan alaa ta'e tokko eebbisuun bananiiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraanni Israa'el iddoo sanaatti qabeenyaafi suuqiiwwan warra Falasxiin erga diiganii boodadha. Gochi kun naannichatti babal'ina lafaa wajjin walqabatee rakkoon jiraatu caalaatti hammaachaa adeemu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
english: Brazilian police have recovered eight stolen illustrations by Henri Matisse, valued at approximately $200,000, from a house near São Paulo. The artworks were taken during a robbery at a library last December, leading to the arrest of a 44-year-old man who allegedly kept them for the thieves. While the Matisse collection has been returned, five other stolen engravings by artist Candido Portinari remain missing.
amharic: የብራዚል ፖሊስ ወደ 200,000 ዶላር የሚገመቱ ስምንት የተሰረቁ የሄንሪ ማቲስ ሥዕሎችን ከሳኦ ፓውሎ አቅራቢያ ባለ ቤት አግኝቷል። ባለፈው ታህሳስ ወር ላይ ከቤተ-መጻሕፍት የተሰረቁት እነዚህ የጥበብ ውጤቶች የተገኙት፣ ለሌቦች ሲጠብቅ የነበረ የተጠረጠረ ግለሰብ ሲያዝ ነው። የማቲስ ሥዕሎች ወደ ቤተ-መጻሕፍቱ የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ ከዚሁ ዘረፋ ጋር የተወሰዱት የካንዲዶ ፖርቲናሪ አምስት የተቀረጹ ሥዕሎች እስካሁን አልተገኙም።
oromo: Poolisiin biyya Brazil, fakkiiwwan Henri Matisse saddeet kan gatiin isaanii gara $200,000 ga'u, mana tokko keessatti argachuun deebiseera. Fakkiiwwan kun ji'a Muddee darbe mana kitaabaa tokko keessaa kan hataman yoo ta'u, nama isaan hidhe keessa ture tokko to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Fakkiiwwan Matisse gara mana kitaabaatti deebi'aniiru, garuu fakkiiwwan kaxxaallaa Candido Portinari shan kanneen hataman sana keessatti argaman amma iyyuu hin argamne.

title: Scrutiny over Farage’s finances has ‘hurt Reform UK support’
english: Although Nigel Farage successfully secured a seat in parliament, political experts believe his party's reputation has suffered. Increased attention regarding his personal financial dealings has negatively impacted public support for Reform UK. Analysts suggest this ongoing controversy is currently hindering the party's growth.
amharic: ናይጄል ፋራጅ በፓርላማ መቀመጫቸውን ማሸነፍ ቢችሉም፣ ስለ ፋይናንስ ሁኔታቸው የሚነሱ ጥያቄዎች በፓርቲያቸው ተወዳጅነት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ አሳድረዋል። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ በግል የገንዘብ ጉዳዮቻቸው ላይ ያለው ትኩረት የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲን ድጋፍ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። ይህ ውዝግብ በአሁኑ ወቅት የፓርቲውን ተቀባይነት እየገደበው ይገኛል።
oromo: Nigel Farage mana maree keessatti bakka bu'ummaa isaa mirkaneeffatus, haalli qabeenya isaa irratti ka'aa jiru hordoffiin isaa paartii isaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa ogeeyyonni siyaasaa ibsaniiru. Dhimmi maallaqaa isaa xiyyeeffannoo argachuun isaa, deeggarsi paartii 'Reform UK' akka hir'atu taasiseera. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, falmiin kun ammaaf guddina paartichaa miidhaa jira.

title: Seven killed in tunnel accident at Indian hydropower project
english: A tragic landslide caused water and debris to flood a tunnel at a state-run hydropower construction site in Uttarakhand, India, resulting in at least seven worker deaths. Thirteen people were injured and rescue teams are currently searching for three additional missing individuals. Experts suggest that intense monsoon rains, combined with aggressive infrastructure development in the fragile Himalayan region, are increasingly leading to such dangerous accidents.

title: What next for Nigel Farage after beating Count Binface to become MP once more?
english: Nigel Farage has been re-elected as the Member of Parliament for Clacton following a by-election he triggered himself amidst a controversy over undisclosed political donations. While Farage secured the victory, the contest was unusual due to a boycott by major political parties, leaving a satirical candidate known as Count Binface as his primary opponent. The win is viewed by many as hollow, especially as Farage faces ongoing parliamentary scrutiny regarding his financial disclosures.

title: Gaza starvation: Why Israel's supporters are misrepresenting Unicef study
english: Israel continues to deny accusations that it is using starvation as a weapon of war in Gaza, despite reports from international human rights organizations and the WHO regarding severe hunger crises. Pro-Israel advocates have recently claimed that a new UNICEF study proves famine in Gaza was a hoax, using the findings to dismiss allegations of war crimes. However, these claims are being criticized as misleading distortions of the data, as the study does not negate the existence of a severe humanitarian crisis.

title: New Zealand break ranks with Oceania as FIFA’s Infantino divide grows
english: New Zealand has officially withdrawn its support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino's re-election following a controversial and now abandoned plan to sell stakes in World Cup commercial rights to private investors. While the Oceania Football Confederation continues to back FIFA leadership, New Zealand is demanding an independent investigation into the matter to restore lost trust. This move aligns New Zealand with other major global confederations that are currently challenging Infantino's governance ahead of next year's election.

title: Russia says hit Ukrainian railway and port facilities in new strikes
english: Russia recently conducted airstrikes against a Ukrainian railway station and vessels near Mykolaiv, claiming they were used for military logistics. In retaliation, Ukraine launched drone attacks against Russian oil infrastructure, including a major Baltic port and a warehouse near Moscow. These ongoing exchanges have prompted regional security alerts and air travel disruptions across both Russia and neighboring Baltic countries.

title: Swiatek defeats Rybakina to claim Canadian Open title​
english: Iga Swiatek secured her first title of the season by defeating Elena Rybakina in the Canadian Open final with a decisive 6-2, 6-3 victory. Although Swiatek dominated the match in Toronto, she revealed feeling emotionally conflicted due to recent public pressure regarding her performance this year. Rybakina struggled to keep up physically, likely due to exhaustion from a demanding schedule leading up to the final.

title: UK far-right leader Farage re-elected in boycotted by-election
english: Nigel Farage has secured re-election as a UK Member of Parliament following a period of resignation linked to financial concerns. The election process was marked by a boycott and a lack of traditional competition, leaving a comedian known as Count Binface as his primary opponent. Farage did not attend the final announcement of the results.
