title: La Liga: Barcelona key talking points heading into new 2026-27 season
english: Barcelona is entering the 2026-27 season aiming for a third consecutive La Liga title, a feat they have not achieved since the Pep Guardiola era. Following their recent dominance over Real Madrid and significant contributions to Spain's recent World Cup victory, the team is widely considered the favorite to win again. Despite the departure of captain Ronald Araujo, the squad remains young and highly talented, though manager Hansi Flick must manage player fatigue after the international tournament.
amharic: ባርሴሎና የፔፕ ጋርዲዮላ ዘመን በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሶስት ተከታታይ የላሊጋ ዋንጫዎችን ለማንሳት በዝግጅት ላይ ነው። በቅርቡ ከሪያል ማድሪድ የላቀ ብቃት ማሳየታቸው እና ለስፔን የዓለም ዋንጫ ድል ያበረከቱት አስተዋፅኦ ቡድኑን የውድድሩ ዋነኛ ተወዳጅ አድርጎታል። ምንም እንኳን አምበሉ ሮናልድ አራውጆ ቢለቅም፣ ወጣቱ የባርሴሎና ስብስብ ለድል ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Barcelona waggaa 2026-27 kana yeroo sadaffaaf walitti aansee waancaa La Liga injifachuuf qophaa'aa jira; kunis yeroo Pep Guardiola booda isa jalqabaa ta'a. Taphattoonni isaanii injifannoo Waancaa Addunyaa Ispeenirratti gahee guddaa taphachuu fi Real Madrid caaluun isaanii, gareen kun lammataayyuu akka mo'atu abdachiiseera. Kabajamuu kaapiteenii isaanii Ronald Araujo fi dadhabbiin taphattootaa mudachuu danda'us, gareen kun dargaggoota guddina guddaa qaban kan qabateefi qophii gaarii irra kan jiru dha.

title: Israeli bombardments in south Lebanon intensify
english: Israeli military forces have significantly increased their aerial and ground operations across southern Lebanon, targeting wooded areas and villages with airstrikes, artillery, and demolition tactics. Recent reports indicate that areas such as Mansouri and Majdel Zoun have faced consistent bombardment and weapon fire. Furthermore, Israeli armored vehicles have been spotted moving through local towns as the campaign of destruction in the region continues.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኙ የደን አካባቢዎችን እና መንደሮችን በአየር ጥቃት፣ በታጠቁ ተሽከርካሪዎች እና በቦምብ ፍንዳታዎች በማጥቃት ኦፕሬሽናቸውን አጠናክረዋል። በተለይም የማንሱሪ እና ማጅደል ዞውን አካባቢዎች ለከባድ የጦር መሳሪያ እና የአየር ጥቃት ተጋልጠዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪዎች በአካባቢው መንደሮች ውስጥ እየተንቀሳቀሱ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለው የጥፋት ዘመቻ ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el gammoojjii fi baadiyaalee kibba Libanoos keessatti duula qilleensaarraa, meeshaa gurguddaa fi diiggaa gaggeessuun tarkaanfiisaanii hammaatanii jiru. Gabaasni akka agarsiisutti, bakkeewwan akka Mansuurii fi Majdel Zoun haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa waraanaatiin miidhamanii jiru. Kana malees, konkolaattonni waraana Israa'el magaalota naannichaa keessa socho'aa jiraachuun ibsamee, duulli diiggaa guutummaatti itti fufee jira.

title: The paediatric war wounds Dr Abu Sittah tries to heal in Lebanon
english: Dr. Ghassan Abu Sittah is currently treating 11 children in Beirut who have suffered severe, life-changing injuries due to the conflicts in Gaza and Lebanon. The surgeon is performing complex reconstructive procedures, including surgeries for amputations and shrapnel-related complications, to help these young patients recover. His primary goal is to repair their bodies so they can regain function and eventually move forward with prosthetic rehabilitation.
amharic: ዶክተር ጋሳን አቡ ሲታ በሊባኖስ እና በጋዛ በተካሄዱ ጦርነቶች ምክንያት ከባድ የአካል ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን 11 ህጻናት በቤይሩት እየታከሙ ይገኛሉ። የቀዶ ጥገና ሐኪሙ የሕጻናቱን ሕይወት ለማሻሻል የአካል መቆረጥ እና የቦምብ ፍንዳታ ቁርጥራጭ ያስከተለባቸውን ጉዳቶች ለመጠገን ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ዋና ዓላማቸውም ህጻናቱ የሰው ሰራሽ አካል ተጠቅመው ወደ ተሻለ የጤና ሁኔታ እንዲመለሱ ማድረግ ነው።
oromo: Doktar Gasaan Abuu Sitaah daa'imman 11 waraana Gaazaafi Libaanoon irraan miidhaa cimaa geessise irra ga'e biiroo isaa kan Bayruut keessatti yaalaa jira. Ogeessi kun miidhaa gosa gara garaa kan akka qaama hir'achuu fi shrapnel irraa ga'e suphuudhaan daa'imman kun gara jireenya isaanii isa duraatti akka deebi'anuf tattaaffii gochaa jira. Kaayyoon isaa inni guddaan daa'imman kun qaama keessoo fayyadamanii jireenya isaanii itti fufuu akka danda'an gargaaruudha.

title: Tanker hit in Hormuz, UKMTO says
english: A commercial tanker was struck by a drone while passing through the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday. Although the ship suffered slight damage, all crew members remain unharmed. Authorities confirmed that there have been no reports of environmental damage following the incident.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል የሚያልፍ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በድሮን ጥቃት ደርሶበታል። መርከቧ መጠነኛ ጉዳት ቢደርስባትም፣ በውስጧ የነበሩት ሰራተኞች በሙሉ ደህና ናቸው። ከጥቃቱ በኋላ ምንም አይነት የአካባቢ ብክለት አለመከሰቱም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa doonii boba'aa fe'atte tokko irratti daandii galaana Hormuz keessa osoo jirtuu rukuttaan doonii miila hin qabne (drone) raawwatameera. Dooniin sun miidhaa xinnoo kan qaqqabeef ta'us, hojjettoonni hundi balaa tokko malee nagaan jiru. Odola kana boodas miidhaan naannoo irra ga'e akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: The Eritrean Script Exposes Ethiopia’s Unity Farce
english: Ethiopia's current political situation in Tigray mirrors the historical failures that led to Eritrea's independence. The government's National Dialogue commission is being criticized for lacking inclusivity, as major political and armed groups remain excluded from the process. By shutting Tigray out of national elections and dialogue, the state risks repeating past mistakes where marginalization fueled conflict rather than unity.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት በትግራይ ክልል እየተከተለ ያለው አካሄድ፣ ኤርትራ ከኢትዮጵያ እንድትገነጠል ካደረጉት ታሪካዊ ስህተቶች ጋር ይመሳሰላል። የኢትዮጵያ ሀገራዊ የምክክር ኮሚሽን፣ ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ እና የትጥቅ ቡድኖችን ያላካተተ በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ይገኛል። መንግስት ትግራይን ከምርጫ እና ከውይይት ሂደቶች በማግለሉ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም የነበሩ መጥፎ ታሪኮች እንዳይደገሙ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Haalli siyaasaa Itoophiyaa amma naannoo Tigraayitti mul’achaa jiru, seenaa kanaan dura Itoophiyaan Eritraan akka gargar baatu kan taasiseef haala wal fakkaatuun adeemaa jira. Koreen Marii Biyyaalessaa Itoophiyaa qaamolee siyaasaa fi waraana guguddaa marii irraa hambisuun isaa mormii cimaa uumeera. Mootummaan Tigraayii filannoo fi marii biyyaalessaa irraa muruun isaa, dogoggorri seenaa darbe deebi'ee akka hin mudanne sodaachisaa jira.

title: Tanzid makes history as Bangladesh dominate first Australia Test
english: Tanzid Hasan made history by becoming the first Bangladeshi player to score a Test century on Australian soil during the opening match in Darwin. Alongside captain Najmul Hossain Shanto, he helped Bangladesh build a commanding 153-run lead by the end of the second day. The tourists finished the day at 351-6, putting them in a strong position to pursue their first-ever Test victory in Australia.
amharic: ታንዚድ ሀሰን በአውስትራሊያ መሬት የቴስት ግጥሚያ ላይ ከመቶ በላይ በማስመዝገብ የመጀመሪያው የባንግላዲሽ ተጫዋች በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርቷል። ከቡድኑ ካፒቴን ናጅሙል ሁሴን ሻንቶ ጋር በመሆን ባንግላዲሽ በሁለተኛው ቀን ማጠቃለያ የ153 የሩጫ ብልጫ እንዲኖራት አድርጓል። ባንግላዲሽ በጨዋታው በስድስት ተጫዋቾች 351 የሩጫ ውጤት በማስመዝገብ በአውስትራሊያ ምድር የመጀመሪያ ድሏን ለማግኘት ጠንካራ አቋም ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Tanzid Hasan taphataa Bangladesh kan jalqabaa biyya Awustiraaliyaa keessatti qabxii dhibba (century) galchuun seenaa hojjateera. Kaapiteenii Najmul Hossain Shanto waliin tahuun, guyyaa lammaffaa irratti Bangladesh qabxii 153 akka dursitu gargaareera. Taphattoonni Bangladesh guyyaa sana qabxii 351-6 irratti xumuruun, Awustiraaliyaa keessatti injifannoo seena qabeessa argachuuf karaa irra jiru.

title: US accuses dozens of countries of helping China avoid Trump’s tariffs
english: The US government has accused over 40 countries, including key trade partners like the EU, Canada, and Mexico, of helping China evade American tariffs. A new White House report claims that these nations are facilitating a massive transshipment scheme where Chinese goods are falsely labeled to enter the US market. The administration warns that this practice costs the US billions in lost revenue and harms domestic workers, promising to use advanced technology to stop such illegal trade activities.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የአውሮፓ ህብረትን፣ ካናዳን እና ሜክሲኮን ጨምሮ ከ40 በላይ ሀገራት ቻይና የጣለችውን የታሪፍ ቀረጥ እንድታመልጥ እያገዙ ነው ሲል ከሰሰ። ነጭ ቤተመንግስት ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሰረት፣ እነዚህ ሀገራት የቻይና ምርቶች በሀሰተኛ መለያ ወደ አሜሪካ እንዲገቡ በማድረግ ከፍተኛ የገቢ ምንጭ እንዲጠፋ አድርገዋል። የአሜሪካ አስተዳደር ይህ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ ሰራተኞች እና ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ጉዳት እያደረሰ መሆኑን ገልጾ፣ ህገ-ወጥ የንግድ ልውውጦችን ለማስቆም ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂዎችን እንደሚጠቀም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyoota 40 ol, kanneen akka gamtaa Awurooppaa, Kaanaadaa fi Meksikoo dabalatee, Chaayinaan gibira Ameerikaa akka hin kaffalle gargaaraa jiru jechuun himate. Gabaasni mana mootummaa (White House) akka ibsetti, biyyoonni kunneen meeshaaleen Chaayinaa maqaa sobaatin akka Ameerikaa seenan taasisuun mala hinkaaffachuu irratti hirmaachaa jiru. Ameerikaan, gochi kun qarshii biliyoonaan lakkaa'amu akka ishee dhabsiisu fi hojjettoota ishee irratti miidhaa akka geessisu ibsuun, daldala seeraan alaa kana dhaabuuf tekinoolojii ammayyaatti fayyadamuuf akka jirtu beeksise.

title: South Korea players want K League season change due to ‘worsening climate’
english: The South Korean Professional Footballers Association is requesting a shift in the K League schedule to avoid playing during the nation's increasingly dangerous summer heatwaves. They argue that moving to a fall-to-spring calendar would protect player health and align the league with European and Asian standards. While officials acknowledge that cold winter weather remains a challenge, they suggest incorporating a winter break to manage the transition effectively.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ ፕሮፌሽናል እግር ኳስ ተጫዋቾች ማህበር፣ በሀገሪቱ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ከፍተኛ የበጋ ሙቀት ለማስወገድ የኬ ሊግ የውድድር መርሃ ግብር እንዲቀየር እየጠየቀ ነው። ከውድቀት እስከ ጸደይ የሚዘልቅ የውድድር ዘመን መከተል የተጫዋቾችን ጤንነት ከመጠበቁም በላይ፣ ከሌሎች የእስያ እና የአውሮፓ ሊጎች ጋር ተመጣጣኝ ያደርጋቸዋል ብለዋል። የክረምት ብርድ የራሱ ፈተና ቢኖረውም፣ በወቅቱ የዕረፍት ጊዜ በመፍጠር ለውጡን ተግባራዊ ማድረግ እንደሚቻል ማህበሩ ያምናል፡፡
oromo: Waldaan taphattoota kubbaa miilaa ogeeyyii Koriyaa Kibbaa, ho'a guyyaa guyyaan dabalaa jiru irraa taphattoota ittisuuf jecha sagantaan tapha K League akka jijjiiramu gaafachaa jiru. Yeroo qorrisaa fi bonaa gidduutti taphattoonni akka taphatan gochuun fayyaa taphattootaa kan eeguu fi sadarkaa addunyaa wajjin kan walsimsiisu ta'uu ibsameera. Gosti qorraa fi cabbiin yeroo bonaa rakkina ta'us, yeroo kana keessa boqonnaa gahaa kennuun jijjiiramicha milkeessuun akka danda'amu waldaan kun yaada dhiyeesseera.

title: Wildfires force thousands to flee as blazes spread across Europe
english: Severe wildfires are spreading across multiple European nations, including France, Germany, Croatia, and Greece, forcing thousands of residents and tourists to evacuate their homes. The blazes have been fueled by extreme heatwaves and prolonged drought conditions, with experts attributing this trend to the ongoing climate crisis. In Croatia specifically, the situation is critical, as several people have been hospitalized due to fires reaching populated coastal areas.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ፣ በጀርመን፣ በክሮኤሽያ እና በግሪክ የሚከሰቱ ከባድ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎችን እና ቱሪስቶችን ለመፈናቀል ተገደዋል። እነዚህ እሳቶች በአህጉሪቱ በተከሰቱት ከፍተኛ የሙቀት ማዕበል እና የረዥም ጊዜ ድርቅ የተነሳ የተቀጣጠሉ ሲሆን፣ ሳይንቲስቶች ይህንን የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ውጤት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። በተለይም በክሮኤሽያ የቱሪስት ከተሞችን በመውረሩ ምክንያት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa cimaa biyyoota Awurooppaa gurguddoo kanneen akka Faransaay, Jarmanii, Kiro'eeshiyaa fi Giriik keessatti ka'een namoonni kumaatamaan lakka'aman mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Ibidni kun hoo'a qilleensaa cimaa fi hongee dheeraa jiraachaa ture hordofee kan babal'ate yoo ta'u, ogeeyyiin jijjiirama qilleensaa waliin akka wal qabatu ibsu. Keessattuu biyya Kiro'eeshiyaa keessatti ibidni kun magaalaalee turizimii dhaqqabuun isaa namoota hedduu miidhee hospitaala akka galan taasiseera.

title: Engine debris shattered Ryanair window, pulling passenger out, NTSB says
english: A Ryanair flight was forced to return to Greece after an engine fan blade failed due to metal fatigue, sending debris that shattered a passenger window. The impact caused a passenger to be partially pulled out of the aircraft, though others managed to pull him back inside safely. While investigators discovered bird remains in the engine, they have not yet confirmed if a bird strike caused the failure, and the investigation is still ongoing.
amharic: የራያናየር አውሮፕላን ሞተር ውስጥ የነበረ የአየር ማራገቢያ ምላጭ በመሰበሩ ምክንያት አውሮፕላኑ ወደ ግሪክ እንዲመለስ ተገድዷል። የሰበረው የሞተር ክፍል መስታወቱን በመምታቱ አንድ ተሳፋሪ በከፊል ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በሌሎች ተሳፋሪዎች እርዳታ ወደ ውስጥ ተመልሷል። ባለሙያዎች በሞተሩ ውስጥ የአዕዋፍ ቅሪት ቢያገኙም፣ ብልሽቱ በአእዋፍ ግጭት ምክንያት መሆኑን እስካሁን አላረጋገጡም፤ ምርመራውም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Raayaanaayer jedhamu tokko, baalleen maashina isaa tokko cabuun isaa hir'ina sibiilaa irraa kan ka'e ta'uu hordofee, gara Gireekitti deebi'uuf dirqameera. Cabbiiwwan maashinichaa foddaa xiyyaarichaa cabsanii naqannaan, imaltoon tokko gara alaatti harkifamee ture; ta'us, imaltoonni biroo inni gara keessatti akka deebi'u gargaaraniiru. Qorattoonni maashinichaa keessatti haftee allaattiiwwanii argatanus, caccabbiin sun sababa dha'icha allaattii ti jedhanii hin mirkaneessine; qorannoonis itti fufee jira.

title: Stolen Matisse art found in Brazil
english: Brazilian authorities successfully recovered eight stolen artworks by Henri Matisse, which have an estimated value of $200,000. Police have taken one individual into custody in connection with the crime. The recovery marks a significant success in the investigation of these missing pieces.
amharic: የብራዚል ባለስልጣናት በፈረንሳዊው ሰዓሊ ሄንሪ ማቲስ የተሰሩ እና ዋጋቸው 200,000 ዶላር የሚገመት ስምንት ስርቆት የደረሰባቸውን የስነጥበብ ስራዎች ማግኘታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ከዚህ ስርቆት ጋር በተያያዘ አንድ ግለሰብ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የጠፉት የስነጥበብ ስራዎች መገኘት ለምርመራው ትልቅ ስኬት ሆኗል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Biraazil hojiiwwan aartii hayyuu fakkii biyya Faransaay Henri Maatis kan gatiin isaanii Doolaara 200,000 ga'u sagal argachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Hojiilee aartii kana hatuudhaan walqabatee namni tokko to'annoo jala ooleera. Qabeenyi kun argamuun isaa qorannoo kanaaf milkaa'ina guddaa dha.

title: South Africa end Nigeria’s Women’s World Cup hope, Ghana beat Ivory Coast
english: South Africa and Ghana have secured the two spots for the FIFA Intercontinental Playoffs after defeating Nigeria and Ivory Coast, respectively. This victory keeps their chances alive for the 2027 Women's World Cup, while Nigeria will miss the tournament for the first time since 1991. Meanwhile, Cameroon, Malawi, Morocco, and Algeria have already earned direct qualification for the World Cup.
amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ጋና ናይጄሪያን እና አይቮሪ ኮስትን በማሸነፍ ለፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ማጣሪያ የጥሎ ማለፍ ጨዋታዎች ሁለት ቦታዎችን ይዘዋል። ይህ ውጤት ለ2027ቱ የሴቶች የዓለም ዋንጫ ያላቸውን ተስፋ ሲያቆይ፣ ናይጄሪያ ከ1991 በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በውድድሩ ሳትሳተፍ ቀርታለች። በሌላ በኩል ካሜሩን፣ ማላዊ፣ ሞሮኮ እና አልጄሪያ ቀጥታ የዓለም ዋንጫ ተሳትፎ ማረጋገጣቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Afrikaan Kibbaa fi Gaanaan biyyoota Naayijeeriyaa fi Ayivori Kosti injifachuun bakka lama kan FIFA Intercontinental Playofff qabatanii jiru. Injifannoon kun abdii isaanii kan bara 2027 World Cup dubartootaaf jiru kan eegu yoo ta'u, Naayijeeriyaan bara 1991 booda yeroo jalqabaaf guddicha kana irraa hafteetti. Gama biraatiin, Kaameruun, Maalaawwii, Moroookoo fi Aljeeriyaan kallattiin qulqullaa'anii jiru.

title: Prichard Colon dies from boxing injury that resulted in 221-day coma
english: Former professional boxer Prichard Colon has passed away at 33, eleven years after suffering a severe brain injury during a 2015 match. Colon had been in a coma for over seven months following an illegal blow to the back of his head during a fight against Terrel Williams. Since regaining consciousness, he required constant medical care until his recent death at his home in Florida.
amharic: የቀድሞው የቦክስ ተወዳዳሪ ፕሪቻርድ ኮሎን እ.ኤ.አ. በ2015 በነበረው የቦክስ ግጥሚያ ወቅት በደረሰበት ከባድ የአንጎል ጉዳት ምክንያት በ33 ዓመቱ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይቷል። አትሌቱ ከተጋጣሚው በተሰነዘረበት ሕገ-ወጥ የጭንቅላት ጀርባ ምት የተነሳ ለረጅም ወራት ኮማ ውስጥ ቆይቶ ነበር። ከኮማው ከወጣ በኋላም ሙሉ ህይወቱን በሌሎች እንክብካቤ ሲኖር ቆይቶ በቅርቡ በፍሎሪዳ በሚገኘው መኖሪያ ቤቱ አርፏል።
oromo: Leenjisaa fi taphataa sabquunnamtii boogsiin beekamu Prichard Colon, erga bara 2015 tapha irratti miidhaa sammuu cimaa erga irra ga'ee booda waggaa 11f miidhamee turee booda waggaa 33tti du'aan boqote. Koloon tapha Terrel Williams wajjin godhe irratti mataa duuba rukuttaa seeraan alaa irra ga'een ji'oota hedduuf komaa keessa ture. Komaa keessaa erga ba'ee booda, lubbuun jiraachuuf gargaarsa yeroo hunda barbaachisaa ture kan ture yoo ta'u, dhiyeenya kana manasaa kan Florida keessatti du'eera.

title: Nigel Farage defeats Count Binface to reclaim UK parliamentary seat
english: Nigel Farage, leader of the Reform UK party, successfully regained his parliamentary seat in the Clacton by-election after resigning his position last month. He defeated the satirical candidate Count Binface, who secured a personal best result despite the major political parties boycotting the vote. Farage framed his victory as a direct mandate from his constituents against the political establishment.
amharic: የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲ መሪ ናይጄል ፋራጅ ባለፈው ወር ስልጣናቸውን ከለቀቁ በኋላ በተካሄደው የክላክተን የድጋሚ ምርጫ የፓርላማ ወንበራቸውን መልሰው አሸንፈዋል። ፋራጅ ዋና ተቀናቃኛቸው የሆነውን እና ቀልደኛ እጩ ተወዳዳሪ በመባል የሚታወቀውን ካውንት ቢንፌስን በድምፅ ብልጫ ማሸነፍ ችለዋል። ዋና ዋናዎቹ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ምርጫውን በቦይኮት ቢተዉትም፣ ፋራጅ ድላቸውን ለተቋቋመው የፖለቲካ ስርአት የተሰጠ ትልቅ ምላሽ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii Reform UK, Naayjel Faaraaj, ji'a darbe sadarkaa isaanii gadi lakkisanii booda filannoo irra deebii Kilaaktan irratti teessoo paarlaamaa isaanii deeffataniiru. Faaraaj dorgomaa isaanii kan ta'e kaadhimamaa qooslaa jedhamuun beekamu Kaawunt Biinfeesiin sagalee hedduun injifataniiru. Paartonni siyaasaa gurguddoon filannoo kana lagatanis, Faaraaj injifannoo isaanii kana sirna siyaasaa biyyattii irratti mo'annoo argatanitti lakkaawaniiru.

title: Morning update
english: The US has announced plans to implement unprecedented economic sanctions and naval blockades against Iran to prevent it from acquiring nuclear weapons and to stabilize energy prices. Meanwhile, tensions have escalated as Iranian-linked drone activity was reported near Erbil, and the UAE confirmed an attack on two of its oil vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, US officials have officially denied false reports claiming that American sailors died or faced a mental health crisis while deployed on the USS Abraham Lincoln.
amharic: አሜሪካ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል እና የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለማረጋጋት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ መልኩ ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እና የባህር ላይ እገዳ ለመጣል እቅድ አላት። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው የተባሉ ድሮኖች በአርቢል አቅራቢያ ታይተዋል፤ የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስም በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ውስጥ ሁለት የነዳጅ መርከቦቿ መመታታቸውን አረጋግጣለች። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ አሜሪካ በ USS አብርሃም ሊንከን የጦር መርከብ ላይ ያሉ ወታደሮች መሞታቸውን ወይም የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እንደገጠማቸው የሚነገሩ ወሬዎች ከእውነት የራቁ መሆናቸውን አስተባብላለች።
oromo: Amerikaa, Iraan meeshaa niwukileraa akka hin arganne ittisuufi gatii boba’aa tasgabbeessuuf, tarkaanfii dinagdeeafi duula galaanaarraa dhoorkuu isa kanaan dura hin beekamne fudhachuuf karoorsiteetti. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, Iraan waliin hidhata qabu kan jedhame sochiin xiyyaraa sarara malee (drone) Erbil naannawaatti mul’ateera, akkasumas UAE markabawwan ishee lama kan boba’aa fe’an handaara Ormuz keessatti haleelamu isaanii mirkaneessiteetti. Kana malees, qondaaltonni Amerikaa oduu sobaa markaba waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln irra jiran irratti loltoonni du’an ykn rakkoon fayyaa sammuu mudate jedhamu dhoorkataniiru.

title: Israel carries out large series of explosions, artillery shelling in south Lebanon
english: The Israeli military has launched a series of intense airstrikes and artillery attacks across various towns in southern Lebanon. These operations included significant explosions and the deployment of drones and warplanes over the affected regions. Reports also indicate that Israeli ground forces have begun advancing toward the town of Hadatha.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ ከተሞች ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ድብደባዎችን እና የመድፍ ተኩስ ከፍቷል። በእነዚህ ጥቃቶች ወቅት ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች የተሰሙ ሲሆን የጦር አውሮፕላኖች እና ድሮኖች በአካባቢው ሲመላለሱ ታይተዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ጦር ወደ ሃዳታ ከተማ እየገሰገሰ መሆኑ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el kibba Libaanoositti magaallota garaa garaa irratti haleellaa qilleensaarraa fi meeshaa gurguddaa ta'e banuu itti fufeera. Haleellaa kana keessatti dhohiinsa gurguddaan kan dhaga'ame yoo ta'u, xiyyaarota waraanaa fi dirooniin naannichatti balali'aa turaniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, waraanni Israa'el gara magaalaa Hadaataatti imaluu jalqabeera.

title: ‘They’re all catastrophic’: The paediatric war wounds Dr Abu Sittah tries to heal in Lebanon
english: British-Palestinian surgeon Dr. Ghassan Abu Sittah is treating numerous children in Beirut suffering from severe, life-altering injuries caused by recent conflicts in Lebanon and Gaza. Many of these young patients, such as the survivors of an airstrike on a family home in Libbaya, require multiple complex reconstructive surgeries to address amputations, burns, and shrapnel wounds. Dr. Abu Sittah continues to work tirelessly through his medical fund to provide these children with the necessary operations and rehabilitation for their long-term recovery.
amharic: ብሪታንያዊው ፍልስጤማዊ የቀዶ ጥገና ሐኪም ዶክተር ጋሳን አቡ ሲታ በሊባኖስ እና በጋዛ በቅርቡ በተካሄዱ ጦርነቶች ምክንያት ለከባድ እና ለዘለቄታው ጉዳት ለተዳረጉ ሕፃናት በቤሩት የሕክምና እርዳታ እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ። ከእነዚህ ታካሚዎች መካከል በሊባያ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት የተረፉት ልጆች የሚገኙበት ሲሆን፣ የሰውነት አካል መጉደልን፣ ከባድ ቃጠሎን እና በተለያዩ የሰውነት ክፍሎች የተሰኩ የጦር መሳሪያ ፍርስራሾችን ለማከም ውስብስብ የቀዶ ጥገና ሕክምናዎችን እየተከታተሉ ነው። ዶክተር አቡ ሲታ እነዚህ ሕፃናት ተገቢውን የሕክምና ድጋፍ እና የመልሶ ማቋቋሚያ አገልግሎት እንዲያገኙ በራሳቸው የሕክምና ፈንድ አማካይነት ጥረታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Ogeessi baqaqsanii hodhuu kan biyya Britaniyaa fi Filisxeem kan ta'an Dr. Ghassan Abu Sittah, waraana Libaanoos fi Gaaza keessatti miidhaa cimaa fi bara baraan isaan irratti hafu irra ga'eef yeroo ammaa Beeyruutitti yaala taasisaaf jiru. Ijoolleen miidhaan kun irra ga'e kun keessumaa haleellaa qilleensaa ganda Libaayaa keessatti raawwatameen booda, miidhaa qaamaa fi gubannoo akkasumas kutaalee meeshaa waraanaa qaama isaanii keessatti hafan baasuuf hojii baqaqsanii hodhuu baay'ee walxaxaa ta'e barbaadu. Dr. Abu Sittah ijoolleen kunneen yaala barbaachisaa ta'e akka argatan fi gara jireenya isaanii isa duraatti deebi'uuf gargaarsa taasisuu isaanii itti fufanii jiru.

title: 'Unprecedented' rains in Japan kill four people
english: Japan's Chiba prefecture experienced record-breaking, life-threatening rainfall that resulted in four deaths and left several others injured. The storm triggered severe flooding and landslides, causing power outages for thousands of homes and major transportation disruptions, including flight delays at Narita Airport. Local authorities issued the highest level of emergency warnings as they continue rescue operations despite the weather conditions beginning to stabilize.
amharic: በጃፓን ቺባ ግዛት በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ እና ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ዝናብ ምክንያት አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ሌሎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ዝናቡ ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ መጥለቅለቅ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት በማስከተሉ በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች ኤሌክትሪክ አጥተዋል፤ የአውሮፕላን በረራዎችን ጨምሮ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎቶችም ተስተጓጉለዋል። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ከፍተኛውን የአደጋ ማስጠንቀቂያ በማውጣት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Chiba kan biyya Jaappaanitti roobni cimaan guyyoota darban keessa roobe lubbuu namoota afurii galaafateera, namoonni biroos miidhamaniiru. Roobni kun lolaa cimaa fi lafti akka guuru waan godheef, manneen kumaatamaan lakka'aman humna ibsaa malee hafaniru, akkasumas geejjibni xiyyaaraa fi daandiin addaan citeera. Mootummaan biyyattii akeekkachiisa yeroo muddamaa olaanaa labsuun hojiin oolchuu fi gargaarsaa akka itti fufu taasiseera.

title: Flock adds safeguards to licence-plate readers after wave of stalking cases
english: Flock Safety is implementing new privacy measures for its license-plate reading cameras following reports that several police officers used the technology to stalk and harass women. The company is reducing the standard time it stores vehicle data and will now require specific case codes for all searches to prevent unauthorized access. Additionally, the system will feature automated alerts for suspicious search patterns and allow agencies to restrict which data can be shared with others.
amharic: የፍሎክ ሴፍቲ ኩባንያ የመኪና ታርጋ አንባቢ ካሜራዎቹን ፖሊሶች ለግል ጉዳይ እና ለስለላ መጠቀማቸው በታወቀበት ወቅት አዲስ ጥብቅ የደህንነት እርምጃዎችን አስተዋውቋል። ኩባንያው የመረጃ ማቆያ ጊዜውን በማሳጠር እና እያንዳንዱ የፍለጋ ስራ በይፋዊ የክስ መዝገብ ቁጥር እንዲያዝ በማድረግ ያልተገባ አጠቃቀምን ለመከላከል ወስኗል። እንዲሁም አጠራጣሪ የፍለጋ እንቅስቃሴዎችን በራስ-ሰር የሚጠቁም እና ለሌሎች አካላት የሚጋራውን መረጃ የሚገድብ አዲስ ስርዓት ተግባራዊ አድርጓል።
oromo: Kampaniin Flock Safety jedhamu kaameraawwan isaa kanneen lakkoofsa gabatee konkolaataa dubbisan poolisoonni haala seeraan alaa ta'een dubartoota hordofuuf itti fayyadamaa turuu isaanii erga gabaafamee booda, tarkaanfiiwwan eegumsa iccitii haarawaa fudhateera. Kampaniin kun yeroo ragaaleen konkolaataa itti kuufaman akka gabaabbatu kan godhe yoo ta'u, barbaacha kamuuf ragaa seeraa (case codes) akka barbaachisu taasiseera. Dabalataanis, sirnichi gochawwan shakkisiisoo ta'an ofumaan kan akeekkachiisu fi ragaaleen garabiraatti darban daangeeffamuu akka danda'an sirreeffama taasiseera.

title: North Korea fumes over upcoming US-South Korea military drills
english: North Korea has strongly condemned upcoming joint military exercises between the United States and South Korea, labeling them as a provocative escalation that brings the region closer to nuclear conflict. The scheduled 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' drills will focus on modern warfare threats, including cyberattacks and drone operations. In response, Pyongyang has threatened to strengthen its military deterrent, claiming that the alliance between the US, South Korea, and Japan now functions as a nuclear-armed bloc.
amharic: ሰሜን ኮሪያ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በደቡብ ኮሪያ መካከል ሊደረግ የታቀደውን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ አጥብቃ በመቃወም፣ ይህም አካባቢውን ወደ ኒውክሌር ጦርነት አፋፍ የሚያደርስ ቅስቀሳ ነው ስትል ከሳለች። 'ኡልቺ ፍሪደም ሺልድ' ተብሎ የሚጠራው የዘንድሮው ልምምድ በሳይበር ጥቃቶች እና በድሮን ቴክኖሎጂዎች ላይ ያተኩራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ለዚህ ምላሽ በሰጠችው መግለጫ ፒዮንግያንግ፣ የሰሜን ኮሪያን የደህንነት ስጋት ለመመከት ወታደራዊ አቅሟን እንደምታሳድግ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Koreaan Kaabaa leenjii waraanaa gama gamanaan Yuunaayitid Isteetes fi Kooriyaa Kibbaa gidduutti taasifamuuf jiru balaaleffatteetti. Leenjiin kun naannichaa gara waraana niwuukilaaraatti akka dhiyeessu ibsuun, hanga 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' jedhamu kanatti of eeggannoo cimaa akka gootu beeksisteetti. Leenjiin waraanaa kunis tajaajila sayberii fi teknolojii doroonii irratti xiyyeeffata jedhameera. Koreaan Kaabaa gamasaatiin, dhiibbaa kana hunda ofirraa ittisuuf qophiin waraanaa ishee akka dabalu ibsiteetti.

title: Fear and attacks grip Taybeh, the last all-Christian town in the West Bank
english: Residents of Taybeh, the final remaining Christian town in the occupied West Bank, are living in constant fear due to escalating attacks and intimidation by Israeli settlers. Families have adopted nightly safety routines, and local business owners have suffered massive financial losses after their properties were vandalized and raided by armed groups. These coordinated assaults have disrupted daily life, leaving children traumatized and residents feeling unprotected as they face increasing threats to their homes and livelihoods.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ የመጨረሻዋ የክርስትና እምነት ተከታዮች ከተማ የሆነችው ታይቤ ነዋሪዎች በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በሚሰነዘርባቸው ጥቃት እና ማስፈራሪያ በከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ለደህንነታቸው ሲሉ የሌሊት ጥበቃን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ የጥንቃቄ እርምጃዎችን በመውሰድ ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ የንግድ ስራ ባለቤቶችም በታጠቁ ቡድኖች ንብረታቸው በመውደሙ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። እነዚህ የተቀናጁ ጥቃቶች የህጻናትን የአእምሮ ሰላም በመንሳትና የነዋሪዎችን የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮ በማወክ የደህንነት ስሜትን አሳጥተዋል።
oromo: Magaalaan Taybeh jedhamtu kan bulchiinsa lafa qabame (West Bank) keessatti argamtu, jiraattonni Kiristaanotaa weerara fi doorsisa gidiraa irraa gahuun jireenya soda keessa jiru. Maatiin fi abbootin qabeenyaa weerara hidhattootaan qabeenyisaanii manca’e fi miidhaa guddaa irra gahee jira. Hojiin guyyuu fi tasgabbiin maatii fi ijoollee kan booressu ta’ee, jiraattonni eegumsa dhabuun rakkoo jireenyaa hamaa keessa akka jiran himu.

title: Record rainfall leaves four dead, thousands stranded in Japan
english: Record-breaking rainfall in Japan's Chiba prefecture has resulted in at least four deaths and significant travel disruptions during the busy Bon holiday week. Flooding caused widespread power outages for over 22,000 households and left thousands of people stranded at train stations and airports. Emergency teams and the military are currently assisting with relief efforts as authorities urge residents in affected areas to seek shelter.
amharic: በጃፓን ቺባ ግዛት የጣለው ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ዝናብ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን በበዓል ወቅት የሚጓዙ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችንም ለችግር ዳርጓል። ጎርፉ ከ22,000 በላይ ቤቶች የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል እንዲቋረጥባቸው ያደረገ ሲሆን በባቡር ጣቢያዎችና በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያዎች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ መንገደኞች ተቸግረዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሠራተኞችና ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በቦታው ተሰማርተው ድጋፍ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ባለሥልጣናትም ነዋሪዎች ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉና ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ቦታ እንዲጠለሉ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Japoon, naannoo Chiba keessatti roobni cimaan roobee lubbuun namoota afur yoo darbu, namoota kumaatamaan lakka'aman imala isaanii irratti rakkinaaf saaxileera. Balaan lolaa kun manneen jireenyaa 22,000 ol irratti humna elektirikii kan kutate yoo ta'u, namoonni baay'eenis buufata baaburaa fi buufata xiyyaaraa keessatti qabamaniiru. Gareen gargaarsaa fi waraanni hojii fayyinsaa irratti bobba'anii kan jiran yoo ta'u, aantonni mootummaa namoota naannoo sana jiran tasgabbii fi bakka nageenya qabu akka barbaadan gorsaniiru.

title: JD Vance says low energy prices for Americans top priority amid US war on Iran
english: US Vice President JD Vance stated that the administration's primary goal during the conflict with Iran is to maintain affordable energy costs for American citizens. While acknowledging that oil prices have recently decreased, he emphasized that keeping fuel prices low remains his top priority. Additionally, he noted that preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons is a key national security objective.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ከኢራን ጋር በሚደረገው ግጭት ወቅት የአሜሪካ መንግስት ቀዳሚ ትኩረት ለዜጎቹ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲረጋጋ ማድረግ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከቀድሞው ማሽቆልቆሉን ቢገልጹም፣ ዝቅተኛ ዋጋን ማስጠበቅ ዋነኛ አላማቸው መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ መከላከል ለሀገሪቱ ሌላው ወሳኝ ጉዳይ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance akka jedhanitti, waraana Iraan waliin jiru keessatti dursi inni guddaan gatiin boba'aa lammiilee Ameerikaaf gatii madaalawaa ta'ee akka itti fufu taasisuudha. Gatiin boba'aa amansiisoo ta'ee akka itti fufu gochuun immoo galma isaanii isa tokkoffaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Iraan meeshaa niwukilaaraa akka hin arganne ittisuun dhimma nageenya biyyoolessaa isa ijoo ta'uu eeraniiru.

title: US Senator Schumer calls for firing of Hegseth over handling of aircraft carrier
english: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer has formally requested the immediate dismissal of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Schumer claims that Hegseth’s poor management of the USS Abraham Lincoln has put American sailors in serious danger. He labeled the official as incompetent and insisted that his leadership is directly responsible for the current crisis.

Kanaafuu, ministeerri kun yeroo ammaa hatattamaan hojiirraa bu'uu qaba jedhaniiru.

title: Centcom denies reports of soldiers dying onboard the USS Abraham Lincoln
english: The U.S. Central Command has officially dismissed recent online rumors claiming that sailors died aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln during its current deployment. Officials clarified that no fatalities have occurred on the aircraft carrier, specifically labeling reports of a deadly fight and increased suicides as completely false. They also confirmed that a single sailor who fell into the sea on August 3 was rescued successfully and is safe.

Kana malees, qondaaltoonni kun ganna darbe guyyaa Hagayya 3 doonii sana irraa kan kufe loltuun tokko saffisaan fayyadamanii lubbuun oolchuu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Christopher Nolan remakes 'The Odyssey' as an Anglo-American imperial fantasy
english: Director Christopher Nolan’s new film adaptation of The Odyssey has premiered, featuring stars like Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway. The film has drawn criticism for its grandiose, imperialistic approach to Greek history, with observers arguing that it promotes a westernized narrative that alienates modern Greeks from their own cultural heritage. Critics suggest that Nolan’s focus on massive cinematic scale obscures the genuine historical and geographical roots of the original epic.

Fiilmichi seenaa Giriikii akkaataa 'Lixaatti' (Western) fayyadamuun dhiyeessuu fi eenyummaa dhugaa uummata Giriikii laaffisa jechuun komatameera. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, Nolaan fiilmiicharratti teeknooloojii gurguddaa fayyadamuun isaa, hiikaa fi seenaa dhugaa suuraa sanaa akka dhoksuu fi dogoggorsu dubbatu.

title: Watch: Turkey's Fidan warns of 'radical steps' if Israel does not comply with Gaza deal
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has stated that Turkey, along with Egypt and Qatar, might implement major measures if the U.S. fails to push Israel to honor the Gaza ceasefire agreement. He noted that while Palestinian representatives have met their obligations, Israel has stalled in moving forward with the second stage of the deal. Fidan is calling on the United States to use its influence to ensure Israel follows through with the necessary commitments.

Kanaafuu, Ameerikaan Israa'el waadaa ishee akka kabajju dhiibbaa gochuu akka qabdu ministirichi gaafataniiru.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is deeply rooted in a social culture that prioritizes absolute obedience over open dialogue. This hierarchical mindset begins at home and in schools, where questioning authority is often viewed as a sign of disrespect or disloyalty. As a result, these patterns of submission and dominance carry over into workplaces and government institutions, preventing the critical thinking necessary for a healthy democratic society.

title: Salvage work begins on tanker leaking oil off Oman, risk firm says
english: A salvage operation has started to stabilize an oil tanker that has been leaking crude off the coast of Oman since June. The ship, suspected of being part of Russia’s shadow fleet, has caused a massive oil spill that is now polluting local beaches and threatening the environment. Despite difficult monsoon weather, international experts are working with Omani authorities to secure the vessel and contain the damage.

title: Water supply for three US states drips down, Lake Mead at record low
english: Lake Mead, the largest reservoir in the United States, has reached an unprecedented low water level. Located between Nevada and Arizona, its decline by two-thirds threatens the water and electricity supply for millions of people. This crisis highlights the severe impact on resources across the western part of the country.

title: Brazil begins exploring retaliatory options to new US tariffs
english: The Brazilian government has begun formal consultations to consider retaliatory measures against the United States in response to new 25 percent tariffs imposed on various Brazilian exports. While no final decision has been reached, Brazil is exploring options such as taxing American imports or suspending certain patents to protect its economy. This move follows the US government's claims of unfair trade practices, which Brazil maintains are unjustified and arbitrary.

title: Mali says 82 soldiers captured by armed groups have been freed
english: The Malian military recently announced that 82 of its soldiers, who had been held captive by armed rebel groups in the northern part of the country, have been released. These troops were freed following mediation efforts by Algeria for humanitarian reasons, though there are conflicting reports regarding how long the individuals were held. While these soldiers are now safe under government care, rebel organizations claim that many others still remain in captivity.

title: Turkey's foreign minister accuses Israel of expelling Palestinians from Gaza
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has accused Israel of planning to forcibly remove all Palestinians from the Gaza Strip. During a meeting in Egypt, Fidan criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies as inhumane and called for urgent international pressure to stop the ongoing conflict. He also claimed that Turkey and Egypt have collaborated to mitigate the violence, even as Israeli military operations in the region continue.

title: Kushner expected to travel to Israel for Gaza talks next week: Report
english: Jared Kushner, serving as a Middle East envoy for President Trump, is planning a trip to Israel next week. The primary goal of his visit is to hold talks regarding the long-term future of Gaza. He intends to discuss strategies to further the progress of the administration's peace initiative for the region.

title: Vance says US will end up 'in a stronger position' than Iran
english: US Vice President JD Vance announced that the administration is utilizing a strategic mix of military, economic, and diplomatic tools to exert pressure on Iran. He criticized the Iranian government for failing to uphold its previous agreements and expressed confidence that current US actions will ultimately ensure Iran does not acquire nuclear weapons. Furthermore, he emphasized that these measures are intended to restore open access to the Strait of Hormuz and secure a dominant position for the United States.
